name: Chromagraph Camera
description:
Replace your phone camera’s default processing with bespoke, curated color and texture rendering designed by cinematographer Steve Yedlin and used on the Knives Out films.

Chromagraph starts from raw image data and builds the image its own way: not a filter laid over the usual look processing, but a different process from the start.

(Chromagraph is a stills-only camera; it does not shoot video. Note that on some devices such as the iPhone 11, not all cameras support raw capture and will not be usable in Chromagraph)

SHOOT FIRST, SEE THE LOOK AFTER
As with a film camera, you frame through the viewfinder and see the finished look only after the image is processed. Take the picture, then open the gallery to see it with the Chromagraph look applied.

ADJUST WITHOUT LOSING THE LOOK
Intuitive yet powerful tools for color, tone, and texture give you real control while keeping every image true to the look that’s the core of the app.

A GALLERY THAT KEEPS THE ORIGINALS
Store full-quality raw files and view them in the app with the look applied live, along with any adjustments you make. Export smaller files to share with friends or save to your photo library, or turn on auto-export in Preferences to send every photo to your library right away as a JPEG or HEIC with the look applied.

NOT A FILTER
A filter sits on top of the processing your phone has already done. Chromagraph skips that processing and uses its own methods for the curated look preferred by director Rian Johnson and cinematographer Steve Yedlin.

name: Money Manager (Remove Ads)
description:
“Money Manager” is an optimized application for personal account management. 

Household account management is complicated. But we make it simple by simplifying the things that are complex. The default settings will get you started, and once you get used to it, you can alter the settings according to your needs with the highly flexible and customizable functions available. 

- Super easy and simple to enter data anytime, anywhere. 
- View your spending tendencies graphically. 
- View statistics by simply entering the data. 
- Search and calculator functions. 
- Set up sub-categories and main categories as necessary. 
- Manage all your accounts at once. 
- Use multiple currencies. 
- Check weekly, monthly, and annual statistics. 
- Use the calendar view. 
- Use budget planning features to plan weekly, monthly, and annual budgets. 
- Change the start date of the month. 

※ Applying double entry bookkeeping 
It facilitates efficient account management. Automatically double entry bookkeeping. 

※ PC manager function 
You can view ‘“Money Manager” application using Wi-Fi or 3G. You can edit and sort the data by date, category or account group on the screen of your PC. In addition, you can see fluctuations of your accounts indicated on graphs on your PC. 

※ Budget management function 
You can manage your budget. It shows your budget and expenditures on a graph so you can compare the amount of your expenditures against your budget quickly. 

※ Credit Card / Debit Card management function 
When entering a future payment date, you can see the payment amount and outstanding balance on the accounts page. You can connect your debit card to your accounts so that expenses are automatically recorded under a specific account. 

※ Passcode 
You can specify the desired time lapse before the app requests a passcode. 

※ Automatic money transfer and frequency functions 
You can set up automatic money transfers between your accounts and configure the frequency of those transfers. 

※ Sort expenses by the recipient 
You can sort your expenses by the recipient and view this information graphically. 

※ Payment Profiles 
You can easily enter frequent expenditures by creating payment profiles. 

※ Backup / Restore 
You can backup and restore your data via email, iTunes and iCloud. 

※ Multiple currency support – you can have individual entries in multiple currencies, and configure each account to calculate the total balance in your desired currency.

Subscription pricing and terms:

Money Manager offers auto-renewing monthly subscription at US$2.49/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at US$19.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Money Manager Data Sync Service while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. 
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. 

Read more about our terms and conditions here:
https://realbyteapps.com/policy/terms.html

Privacy Policy:
https://realbyteapps.com/policy/privacy.html

name: ROLLIE'S: 35mm Film Camera
description:
A little camera shop in your pocket.

Choose a camera. Pick a lens. Load a roll. Every combination has its own look, baked live into the viewfinder before you ever press the shutter. No sliders, no presets to scroll: you compose the feel by choosing your gear, the way you would with real film.

A roll is 36 shots, and there is always another: every film on the shelf is yours, roll after roll.

• A real optical pipeline — body colour science, lens character, and film stock, layered the way light actually stacks up
• Live viewfinder preview: what you see is what develops
• 100 film stocks, each with its own mood — pastel, golden, green, black & white and more
• Everything is included — no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases
• Your photos stay on your device. No account, no sign-in.

Shoot your day the way it felt.

name: AnkiMobile Flashcards
description:
Your decks, wherever you go! AnkiMobile is the official Anki app for iPhone and iPad, the flashcard app that more than 15 million learners worldwide have loved and trusted for over 20 years, made by the team behind Anki and AnkiWeb. Your purchase directly supports the open-source project that keeps Anki desktop free for everyone. Sync is included at no extra cost: no subscription, no sync fees. 

What you get:
 - Free sync with AnkiWeb. Keep your decks and study progress in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux, and the web. Add cards on your computer, study them on your phone.
 - The same SM-2 and FSRS scheduling as desktop Anki, so you review material right as you're about to forget it.
 - A flexible interface designed for smooth and efficient study.
 - Detailed graphs and statistics about your progress.
 - Support for large collections, including 100,000+ cards.
 - Offline study. Media (images and audio) is stored on your device.
 - Powerful search for building filtered decks, e.g. "tagged high priority, answered in the last ten days, and not containing these words".
 - MathJax equations and LaTeX rendering.
 - Apple Pencil support for adding hand-drawn images to cards.

Good to know: AnkiMobile works alongside the desktop version of Anki. Some tasks might require the desktop version, and add-ons are not supported on mobile yet.
Sync is optional. You can also import and export data over USB or AirDrop.

Buy once and use AnkiMobile on all your devices with the same Apple ID. Family Sharing is also supported. Educational institutions can find bulk discounts information through Apple's Volume Purchase Program.

Need help? The manual and support resources are at https://docs.ankiweb.net/ankimobile/support. If you have questions or want to report an issue, contact us through our support site.

name: Tiny Computers
description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: LumaFusion

Welcome to the App Store’s “App of the Year” for 2021 and the recipient of the Editors’ Choice Award! The gold standard for storytellers worldwide. Offering a fluid, intuitive, touch-screen editing experience.
 
PROFESSIONAL EDITING MADE EASY

LAYERED EFFECTS AND COLOR CORRECTION
• Green screen, luma, and chroma keys: For creative compositing.
• Lock & Load Video Stabilizer: Steady your footage.
• Powerful color correction: Create your own look. 
• Video Waveform, vector and histogram scopes.
• LUTs: Import and apply multiple .cube or .3dl LUTs.
• Unlimited keyframes: Animate effects with precision.
• Customizable text and effect presets: Save and share your favorite animations and looks.
• Grids and Guides: Precisely align elements with Title-Safe, Action-Safe and horizon line.
 
ADVANCED AUDIO CONTROL
• Graphic EQ, Parametric EQ and Voice Isolation: Fine-tune audio.
• Keyframe audio levels, panning, and EQ: Craft seamless mixes.
• Stereo and Dual-mono audio support: For interviews with multiple mics on one clip.
• Audio Ducking: Balance your music and dialogue.
• Third-party audio plugins: Enhance your sound.
 
CREATIVE TITLES AND MULTILAYER TEXT
• Multilayer titles: Combine shapes, images, and text into your graphic.
• Customizable fonts, colors, borders, and shadows: Design eye-catching titles.
• Import custom fonts: Strengthen your brand.
• Save and share title presets: Perfect for collaboration.
 
PROJECT FLEXIBILITY AND MEDIA LIBRARY
• Aspect ratios for all uses: From widescreen cinema to social media.
• Frame rates from 18fps to 240fps: Flexibility for any workflow.
• Edit from Photos, Frame.io, and directly from USB-C drives: Access your content anywhere.
• Import media from cloud storage: Wherever you store it.
 
SHARE YOUR MASTERPIECES
• Control resolution, quality, and format: 
• Share movies to social media, local storage or cloud storage.

ENHANCED FEATURES (purchase individually, or get them ALL as part of the Creator Pass subscription - see below)
• Speed Ramping and Enhanced Keyframing - Create speed ramps, Bézier curves, and easing with this one-of-a-kind, easy to use feature.
• XML Export: Send your project to Final Cut Pro for Mac
• Multicam Studio: Synchronize 6 cameras or audio and tap to switch angles

CREATOR PASS SUBSCRIPTION 
• Get full access to Storyblocks for LumaFusion: Millions of High-quality royalty-free music, SFX, and videos, PLUS get ALL the Enhanced Features above.

EXCEPTIONAL FREE SUPPORT
• Online tutorials: www.youtube.com/@LumaTouch
• Reference Guide: luma-touch.com/lumafusion-reference-guide
• Support: lumatouch.co/support

name: Deck-Man: Cassette Player
description:
Deck-Man (formerly referred to as "duo-man") is a playful music player that brings the look, feel, and simplicity of classic portable cassette players to your iPhone Duo.
Turn your phone into a retro cassette player. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Just your music, with a little nostalgia.

A Cassette Player Reimagined:
Open your phone, browse your favorite albums as cassette tapes, insert one into the player, and close it to start listening.

The Little Details make that make it fun:
Browse your albums as cassette tapes and load them into your player.
Enjoy familiar play, pause, fast-forward, and rewind controls.
Hear authentic mechanical clicks and cassette sounds recorded from a real portable cassette player.
Enjoy playful interactions inspired by the original cassette-playing experience.

Your Music Your Way
Listen to your favorite albums with support for Apple Music and local music files.

Buy Once.
No ads. No Upsells. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No interruptions.


Deck-Man has been featured by TechCrunch, 9to5Mac, MacRumors, and TechRadar for its imaginative take on the classic portable cassette player.

name: Duo Aquarium
description:
A living aquarium that changes with iPhone Duo. Fold it part-way for your desk. Open it flat to explore the tank. Choose the fish, plant a freshwater scene or build a reef, and share the view with someone else.

DESIGNED FOR iPhone Duo
• Fold part-way into a tabletop position to enter Desk view automatically. The aquarium and clock stay above the hinge, with feeding, lighting and aquarium controls below.
• Open the device flat to return from automatic Desk view to the full aquarium.
• The native layout responds to the hinge and keeps controls clear of the fold.
• On other iPhones, iPad and Mac, enjoy the aquarium and Desk view in their own screen layouts.

BUILD YOUR AQUARIUM
• Choose freshwater and reef fish, from shoaling tetras and angelfish to clownfish, tangs and gobies.
• Add plants, corals, anemones, rocks and wood. Place coral on live rock and adjust your scenery.
• Moving water, rippling light and real 3D scanned coral give the tank depth.
• Feed your fish and watch them gather. Tap a resident or piece of scenery to identify it.
• Take a clean picture of your tank with the controls hidden.

A CLOCK BESIDE THE WATER
• Desk view combines your aquarium with a clock, date and optional local weather.
• Choose the clock's position, font and format, or show just the tank.
• Switch between daybreak, daylight, moonlight and reef-blue lighting, with a daily light cycle and an evening dim.
• Play optional calm music and water sound, or keep it silent.

SHARE YOUR TANK
• Let a friend visit using your tank code or link. They see your fish, scenery and lighting, while their own tank stays saved.
• Place two nearby devices side by side and stretch one tank across them. Fish swim between the screens and either device can feed them.
• Nearby sharing uses Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Visiting a shared tank uses the internet; hosting requires iCloud.

SMALL DAILY DETAILS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your tank and last feeding.
• Set an optional daily feeding reminder, or feed through Siri and Shortcuts.
• Keep the tank in a window or full screen on Mac.

Your tank is saved on your device. No ads or tracking. Sharing stays off until you enable it, and you can stop it at any time.

iPhone Duo fold features require iOS 27.1 or later. iPhone, iPad and Mac are trademarks of Apple Inc. iPhone Duo is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: Card Vault by YourCardJourney
description:
Card Vault keeps your debit and credit card details in one place, so you never have to hunt through apps or old notes just to check an expiry date or copy a card number.

It runs entirely on your iPhone. There is no account to create and no server to sign in to, and the app makes no network requests of any kind.

HOW IT WORKS
Everything is stored in a single AES-encrypted file, unlocked with a master password you choose the first time you open the app. That password is the one and only gate. Once you are in, the full number and CVV are one tap away, and values stay masked until you reveal them, so a glance over your shoulder shows nothing.

FACE ID, IF YOU WANT IT
Turn on Face ID or Touch ID and unlock the vault with a single tap. Your master password is kept in the iPhone Keychain and released only on a match — the vault file itself is still protected by that password, and you can always type it instead.

BUILT FOR HOW CARDS ACTUALLY WORK IN INDIA
• Grouped by bank, each with its own theme — HDFC, ICICI, Axis, SBI, Kotak, IndusInd, IDFC, Amex and twenty more
• Credit or debit, and a nickname for the card you actually call “the travel card”
• Whose card it is — yours, your spouse’s, your family’s — with a home view you can pin
• Search by bank, name, nickname or the last four digits
• Scan a card with the camera to fill in the number, expiry and name — read on your iPhone, nothing photographed, saved or sent
• Priority Pass numbers stored with the card they came with
• Add-on cards branch off their primary, and a relationship view shows how your cards sit together

MADE TO PROTECT ITSELF
• Locks automatically after you leave the app — after 30 seconds, 1, 2 or 5 minutes, your choice
• The card list is covered in the app switcher
• A copied card number is wiped from the clipboard after 45 seconds
• Your vault is excluded from iCloud and iTunes/Finder backups

WORKS WITH THE DESKTOP APP
Card Vault uses the same encrypted file format as the Windows and Mac versions, so you can move a vault between your PC and your iPhone by exporting and importing it — with the same master password, and without anything touching a network on the way.

NOTHING ELSE
No ads. No analytics. No tracking. No sign-in. No subscription. One purchase, yours to keep.

Shared by @YourCardJourney

name: Voice Recorder - Audio Record
description:
Live sound with its true feelings. Enjoy recording, playback and audio editing with Voice Recorder. We have fine tuned it for your day-to-day activities. Attending something important and want to record it
for later playback, Voice Recorder will allow you to record your meetings, lectures, and other events with codec noise reduction technology. You can record anything within 10-100 meters around you.

Edit the recording as per your need and save it for later playback. Voice Recorder has multiple playback options helping you decide how you want to hear your recording. Developed specially for Apple, it plays just as excellent with Apple EarPods as it plays with our old earphones.

You can auto upload and even share the recording on cloud (Dropbox) in seconds. 

Voice Recorder is an easy to use and handy app to record the meeting, lecture, music and many more. The interface is designed to make it quick. With single tap you can record and share the recordings.

Enjoy sound, record, edit, play and listen!

List of Features

# Audio Recorder
- Quality options: (Low:8KHz, Medium:22.05KHz, High:44.1KHz)
- Format options: (WAV, CAF, M4A)
- External input device support : Bluetooth Mic, Other External Mic (Tested with Tascam mic)
- Background recording support

(New)
- Continue recording into existing recordings.
- Call Interruption handling - Recording will continue after a call or other interruption.

# Audio Player
- Quick audio player
- Playback controls (Fast backward, Fast backward)
- External output device support (Bluetooth and External speaker devices)

# AVAILABLE IN 11 DIFFERENT LANGUAGE
English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português (Br.),Português, Italiano, 中文 (Simplified), Русский, 日本語, 한국어

name: Metar-Taf
description:
Visualized METAR and TAF weather information for all airports in the world. Concise summary of everything you need to know about today's aviation weather. 

METAR features: 
- Visualized in easy to understand and colourful metrics
- Weather symbols for significant weather and clouds, like in a non-aviation weather report
- Crosswind calculations, by combining METAR and runway information
- Flight rules category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR
- Read out by text-to-speech available, listen to a decoded METAR while doing other things

TAF features:
- TAF broken down and displayed per hour in a table
- Show sunrise/sunset, minimum and maximum temperature

Keeping track:
- Add your favorite stations to the list, see their weather at a glance
- Get observations near your location
- Find stations in the interactive map with weather codes
- Search airports by ICAO code or name

History:
- Graphs with weather trends today and yesterday: temperature, visibility, wind speed, QNH
- METAR history for the last hours and link to more on the website

Airport information:
- See information about the airports, like runway directions, elevation, location 
- If the airport doesn't report a METAR, the nearest station used for calculations

Calculations:
- All units are customizable units: speed (knots, km/h, m/s, mph), altitude (meters/feet), visibility (kilometers/miles), temperature (Celcius/Fahrenheit) and air pressure (Hectopascal, Inch Hg)
- Times are converted to the local time for each airport
- Sunrise and sunset are calculated based on the airports latitude/longitude

General:
- METAR, TAF and airport data are automatically saved for offline use
- Available in 6 languages: English, Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French

name: TypeDraw
description:
TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook to a notes app built for everyday life, with all the digital tools that make it useful and the freedom to make it yours. Type, draw and scribble wherever your thoughts take you and know that a little digital magic will help you find it all again when and where you need it.

No account required. No subscription. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Open to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. Or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget.

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way round.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout.

- Make it yours! Turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour either for all pages or for one specific page only and get really crazy. Pick lined, grid or dotted paper, and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts or choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts.

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

name: Fuzz Cam: Vintage Film Camera
description:
Fuzz Cam turns everyday photos into vintage film memories, dreamy portraits and sparkling Live Photos. Choose from eight camera styles, take a photo or give an existing photo a new look.

FILM COLOR, SOFT GLOW AND GRAIN
Explore HaD, NoD, KoD, Dreamcore, Late Autumn and Neon for cool tones, warm colour, soft light and film-inspired texture. These six styles apply their effects after capture.

TWO KIRA SPARKLE CAMERAS
Dreamcore kira combines dreamy colour with bright starbursts. Clear kira adds sparkles to a clear, natural look. Both show the effect in real time and capture Live Photos, so you can keep the movement as well as the light.

MAKE HOLIDAY LIGHTS SPARKLE
Point either kira camera at Christmas tree lights, street lights or small reflections on glass. Bright points in the scene become the source of the sparkle effect.

EDIT PHOTOS AND LIVE PHOTOS
Import a photo or an existing Live Photo and choose any of the eight camera effects. Motion plays once when processing is complete; press and hold to replay. Save an edited Live Photo with its motion preserved.

A CAMERA FEEL, AN ALBUM TO KEEP
Switch between camera bodies, use the shutter button and browse your photos and Live Photos in the in-app album.

ONE PURCHASE, ALL FEATURES
Fuzz Cam is a paid download. One upfront purchase includes every camera and feature. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Purchases and refunds are handled by Apple.

SUPPORT
Questions or feedback: calfcri@icloud.com

PRIVACY
All image processing takes place on your device. Device identifiers and usage events are collected to improve the experience.
Privacy Policy: https://fuzzcam.help/legal/privacy/index.html
Terms of Service: https://fuzzcam.help/legal/terms/index.html

name: Universalis
description:
Universalis is a missal and a breviary, and more besides. It gives you the Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office) and the Mass for every day; plus valuable additional material. 

Tens of thousands of people use Universalis daily. Come and join them!

• Single purchase: the app lasts for ever. It does not need a subscription to make it work.
• No Internet needed: everything you need is already built in.
• No cleverness needed: each day, Universalis works out exactly what you need to see.
• View any date: past, present and future.
• Use your own local calendar: USA, Canada, Singapore, Ireland, and every diocese in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.
• Easy to read and use: a choice of fonts; big or small type; dark or light theme; page-turning or scrolling.
• Optional add-on: spoken audio read by real human beings (this needs a subscription: see below).
• Latin if you want it: by itself or alongside the English.

name: Puffin Browser Pro
description:
Puffin Cloud Browser is the client app that accesses the cloud server which runs the web browser. The Puffin client app and the Puffin cloud server do not communicate in HTTP protocol and the data exchange is not in HTML format. The Puffin client app is like the remote desktop client and the Puffin cloud server is like the remote desktop server. Puffin Cloud Browser gives the audience the illusion of a web browser but it is not, in reality, a web browser. Puffin Cloud Browser can only "display" the web content rendered on the cloud servers but can't "render" the web content itself on the client devices.

==== Differentiating Features ====
* Browser Isolation
* Cloud Acceleration
* Data Saving
* Download to Cloud
* Flash Game
* Full Desktop Mode
* Internet Access Protection
* Virtual Gamepad/Mouse/Trackpad

==== Important Limitations ====
* Only works on websites that are publicly accessible from the US
  -- Does not work for private IP, corporate Intranet, and geo-restricted websites
* Only works in countries that are not excessive in censorship
  -- Does not work in China, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates

* For some websites, Puffin server IP blocks need to be white-listed
  -- Puffin can bring an excessive load to some websites

More info at Puffin FAQ https://help.puffin.com/faq

name: AltoPaint: Oil & Watercolor
description:
Curiously small paintings, in a paint tin that fits in your pocket.

Open the lid and there's a tiny canvas inside, with twelve pigments and a mixing tray below. AltoPaint's paint behaves like paint: colors mix the way real pigments do, the brush runs dry, wet strokes drag into each other, and thick paint catches the light.

THERE'S NO UNDO
Just like real paint. Paint over it, scrape it back with the knife, or let it set and work on top. Nothing is ever ruined; it just becomes part of the painting.

TWELVE REAL PIGMENTS
Titanium white, lemon yellow, cadmium yellow, yellow ochre, cadmium red, quinacridone magenta, ultramarine blue, phthalo blue, viridian, burnt sienna, raw umber and Payne's grey. Colors are mixed from each pigment's real reflectance across the spectrum, not from RGB, so blue and yellow make a true green and tints come out clean.

OIL, WATERCOLOR OR GOUACHE
Start each painting in oil on a warm toned canvas, glossy and slow to dry; in watercolor on white paper, with transparent washes that spread through wet paper and dry with soft, darker edges; or in gouache on white paper, matte and quick to set.

THREE TOOLS
The round brush for everyday marks, the flat for broad strokes with a chisel edge, and the palette knife for flat planes, scraping and smearing. Hold a brush to choose small, medium or large, and pinch to zoom in for finer marks.

READY FOR APPLE PENCIL
Pressure, tilt and azimuth all shape the stroke. Lay the Pencil over to scumble with the side of the brush, and double-tap to switch to the knife.

A GALLERY IN THE TIN
Every painting is saved as you go. Share your favorites as images.

No account, no ads, no subscription. Pay once and it's yours.

Made in New York by High Line Labs.

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination! 
 
The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)!  
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape! 
 
CREATE YOUR WORLD 
• Build anything from the ground up 
• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes 
• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures 
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace 
• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server 
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more 
• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES 
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others 
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account 
• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you 
• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server*  
• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds 
• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters

The most elegant and professional game clock for serious board game players. Trusted by tournament players worldwide for Chess, Go (Baduk/Weiqi), Shogi, and all competitive turn-based games.

- Tournament-Grade Accuracy: Precision timing trusted by competitive players

name: Only You Are Here
description:
Only You Are Here — an atmospheric adventure with first-person horror elements. 

Take on the role of a person trapped inside their dream. This place is filled with a mix of memories and nightmares. To get out, you have to open a small door.

Immerse yourself in the game's history, walk through many endings, and discover the key secret.

name: Taboo
description:
Can you describe an APPLE without using the words RED, FRUIT, PIE, CIDER or CORE?

Taboo is the ultimate brain-teasing, word-twisting adult party game. Play with video chat and throw a house party on your phone! Split into two teams and take it in turns to describe the words on the cards. Your team has to guess as many as possible before the timer runs out. 

If you use a taboo word by mistake, the other team will buzz and you’ll lose a point. 

Think fast and talk your way to victory!

HOW TO PLAY TABOO: 
1. Start a game and invite your friends. 
2. Split into two teams and name your team.
3. The app chooses a Clue-giver for each team. Each team then takes their turn!
4. The Clue-giver draws a card. The Clue-giver must describe the word without saying any of the words on the card.
5. Team B will buzz if the Clue-giver says a taboo word!
6. Your team must guess as many words as possible before the time runs out.

FEATURES
- FULLY CUSTOMISABLE – Decide the number of players, rounds, how many turns per round and how many skips are allowed.
- AD-FREE GAME – Have fun with zero ads to distract you.
- COMPLETE STARTER CARD DECK – Includes cards from the original game. Expand your game further with additional themed decks!
- FULLY TRANSLATED – Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Greek, Polish and Hindi.

Get the perfect party game on your mobile now!

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description:
***PLEASE NOTE: This game is officially supported on the following devices only: iPhone 4s, 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6s, 6 Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, iPod Touch 6th Gen, iPad Mini 1, 2, 3 & 4, iPad 2, 3rd Gen, 4th Gen, iPad Air 1 & 2, and iPad Pro.***


Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features:  
• Remastered, high-resolution graphics built specifically for mobile including lighting enhancements, an enriched color palette and improved character models. 
• Enhanced for the iPhone 5 series and iPad 4th Gen and above with dynamic detailed shadows and real-time environmental reflections.
• Physical controller support for all Made for iOS controllers.
• Cloud save support for playing across all your iOS devices for Rockstar Social Club Members.
• Dual analog stick controls for full camera and movement control.
• Three different control schemes and customizable controls with contextual options to display buttons only when you need them.

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese.

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
description:
Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.

From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Vice City, a huge urban sprawl ranging from the beach to the swamps and the glitz to the ghetto, was one of the most varied, complete and alive digital cities ever created. Combining open-world gameplay with a character driven narrative, you arrive in a town brimming with delights and degradation and given the opportunity to take it over as you choose. 

To celebrate its 10 year anniversary, Rockstar Games brings Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to mobile devices with high-resolution graphics, updated controls and a host of new features including: 

• Beautifully updated graphics, character models and lighting effects 
• New, precisely tailored firing and targeting options 
• Custom controls with a fully customizable layout

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 5
description:
Face the puppetmaster behind the horrors of Playtime Co. in the latest chapter of the official Poppy Playtime adventure. Descend deeper than ever before, survive Huggy Wuggy's relentless pursuit, and uncover secrets years in the making.

---Enter The Prototype's Domain---
Your journey has brought you into the darkest depths of the factory. Abandoned by your allies, you must venture alone into a realm ruled by The Prototype, where every shadow hides another piece of Playtime Co.'s horrifying past.

---Survive What Lurks Below---
Huggy Wuggy is hunting you once again but he isn't the only thing waiting in the darkness. Encounter the tortured inhabitants of The Prototype's domain. Some may help you survive. Others may have very different plans.

---New Tools. Deadlier Challenges.---
Your GrabPack gains new tools and functionality as the dangers of Playtime Co. grow more deadly.
- Master new GrabPack tools and abilities.
- Solve devious new environmental puzzles.
- Overcome deadly obstacles deep within the factory.
- Encounter new characters whose motives may not be what they seem.
- Uncover some of Playtime Co.'s darkest secrets yet.

You've spent four chapters searching for answers.
Now you're approaching the rotten heart of Playtime Co.
Can you survive The Prototype's domain?

name: Messiahs
description:
Can you convert the whole world to your religion?

A new faith is born and you are chosen to spread it.
Humanity will always find a reason to hate you. You need to use your words and miracles and improve your faith in order to spread it to the entire world. You must speak to people without gaining much hatred, visit cities and right wrongs with miracles.

You will meet hundreds of people and stories on your journey, starting either from Egypt, Jerusalem, or Rome and will get one of the twenty endings as you try to spread your faith.

You can upgrade your religion to reach more people and improve yourself to perform miracles or cause calamities.

Your words will create chaos in the world, and you must handle hatred, lies, kings, and demons to create a religion that all can follow.

name: Grounds Up
description:
Open one café. Grow it into an empire.
Hotels, an AI lab, a fund, board seats.
Pay once. No ads. Works offline.

Grounds Up is a single-player business tycoon game for iPhone. You open your first small café on a busy street. Each week you set prices, pay your people, pick your coffee and read the results. Then the company grows far beyond coffee: more cafés in more cities, hotels, an AI lab and a fund of your own.

Time moves only when you tap the date, one week at a time. There is no timer and no game over. Everything in the game is made up: the companies, the people, the banks and the money. It is a game, not a financial service, and nothing in it is financial advice.

A GROUP THAT KEEPS GROWING
• Build cafés in eight cities: Osaka, Tokyo, New York, Chicago, London, Paris, Berlin and São Paulo.
• Choose the look, the machines, the menu and the prices of every café, and hire managers to run them.
• Open hotels. Pick the class, the rooms and the rates, and read the guest reviews.
• Start an AI lab and grow it through research, products and funding rounds.
• Run a fund with outside investors and a record that sets the size of the next one.
• Lease offices, buy property, and buy and name landmarks.

STAKES, BOARDS AND VOTES
• Buy shares in listed companies and back startups through their funding rounds.
• Build a stake big enough for a seat on the board, then more seats, then the chair.
• Sit in board meetings. Read the facts, weigh the options and vote, or let your seats vote for you.
• Win control of a company and merge it into your group.

RIVALS AND RECORDS
• 300 rival tycoons grow their own fortunes while you build yours.
• Climb the rich list and chase records, from your first billion up.
• Play Relaxed, Normal, Hard or Tycoon, with up to five rival companies.

PAY ONCE, NOTHING ELSE TO BUY
• One payment on the App Store.
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No subscription.
• Works offline. The game never needs the internet.
• No account. No tracking. Keep up to ten games on your phone.

All companies, people and money in the game are made up. Nothing here is financial advice.

name: Beat the Boss 2 (17+)
description:
The Boss is back and ready to make your life a living hell. But you're not the same good guy taking order anymore. You've been granted the power to take sweet vengeance on this tyrannical boss. Backed by an arsenal of dangerous weapons, Beat the Boss with magical forces, lethal guns and deadly blades. Let him PAY THE PRICE of messing with the wrong guy.

Beat the Boss 2 is the highly anticipated sequel to the original title. With 50 million downloads to date; it strives to better what made the first one a hit in every possible way. The simple controls remain the same but it offers new art, weapons, stages, sound effects, and enhanced gameplay. This is not a good game; it’s a freaking awesome one! Why?

- Laugh your face off funny: These aren't jokes for your grandma.
- Physics Simulated: Get a satisfying reaction to all your intense beating
- Premium Weapons: 80+ all new skull cracking, bone breaking, nerve-racking weapons.
- New Town Map: 7 interactive stages, each with their own bosses and secrets to discover.
- New way to play: Funny player objectives and premium rewards.

name: Hitman: Absolution
description:
Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns to iOS in Hitman: Absolution.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments that reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground.

Expertly adapted for mobile play, Absolution’s sleek touchscreen controls offer 47’s hallmark precision, with gamepad and keyboard & mouse support included for the full AAA experience on the go.

SIGNATURE STYLE
Blend into the background, kill silently, and disappear without trace, or go in all guns blazing! Absolution’s missions invite you to experiment, improvise and perfect your technique.

COMPLETE CONTROL
Customise touch controls until they fit you like a glove, or connect a gamepad or any keyboard & mouse that is compatible with iPadOS.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where both his loyalties and his conscience are put to the test.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movement, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Use Point Shooting to stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, or take the ultimate test in Purist mode, with deadlier enemies and no help to guide you.

CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

===

We recommend playing Hitman: Absolution on iOS 18 or later. You need 12GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

Supported iPhones:  

 • iPhone XR and later
 • iPhone SE - 2nd Generation (2020) and later

Supported iPads:  

 • iPad - 8th Generation (2020) and later
 • iPad mini - 5th Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad Air - 3rd Generation (2019) and later
 • iPad Pro - 3rd Generation (2018) and later

name: Ala Mobile
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer
description:
SOLVE A CRYPTIC BOX
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is the first standalone chapter to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Join forces with a friend and play as detective partners Ally and Old Dog in our debut two-player escape room adventure.



IMPORTANT: "Unboxing the Cryptic Killer" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game, that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac. Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community!



Two seasoned detectives, Ally and Old Dog, are entangled in a chilling unsolved case. Lured on a perilous trail, they fall into the clutches of the enigmatic Cryptic Killer they've been relentlessly pursuing. The stakes are sky-high as two innocent lives hang in the balance. In order to save them, Ally and Old Dog must unravel a box of intricate puzzles masterfully designed by the nefarious killer. Test your mettle and join this high-stakes race against time, where every puzzle solved is a step closer to unmasking the Cryptic Killer.



THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is a puzzle for exactly two players. The name of the game is collaboration. Each player takes on one of the two roles and works their way through a series of challenging puzzles. You'll each see one half of the same puzzle and must work together to crack the codes and escape the Cryptic Killer's clutches.



FEATURES LIST
▶Two Player Co-Op 
In Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner, and will be tested on your communication!
▶Challenging Collaborative Puzzles
Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes.
▶Unravel a Thrilling Story
Track the Cryptic Killer's movements as Detectives Old Dog and Ally in this ongoing murder mystery saga.
▶Explore Illustrated Worlds
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer features hand-illustrated environments that are inspired by noir novels.
▶Draw on… Everything!
You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment.

name: The Past Within
description:
Note: The Past Within is a co-op only game. Both players need to own a copy of the game on their own device (mobile, tablet or computer), as well as a way to communicate with each other. Play together with a friend or find a partner on our official Discord server!

The past and future cannot be explored alone! Team up with a friend and piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives! 

The Past Within is the first co-op only point-and-click adventure set in the mysterious world of Rusty Lake.

Features:

▪ A co-op experience 
Play together with a friend, one in The Past, the other in The Future. Work together to solve the puzzles and help Rose set her father’s plan in motion!
▪ Two worlds - Two perspectives 
Both players will experience their environments in two different dimensions: 2D as well as in 3D - a first-time experience in the Rusty Lake universe!
▪ Cross-platform
As long as you can communicate with each other, you and your partner of choice can each play The Past Within on your preferred platform: Mac, PC and Nintendo Switch!
▪ Playtime & Replayability
The game contains 2 chapters and has an average play-time of 2 hours. For the full experience, we recommend replaying the game from the other perspective. Plus you can use our replayability feature for a fresh start with new solutions to all puzzles.

name: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
description:
With greater power and menace than ever before, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance brings forth a fresh, exhilarating experience, building upon the lightning-paced and captivating gameplay that propelled its predecessors to award-winning status.

While a formidable evil emerges, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army to stop it. Beware! Though they may journey side by side the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.

Prepare to harness the formidable might of dual heroes on the battlefield!
YES, now you can play not only with one dragon but with TWO! Double the fire-breathing fun, double the chaos—just make sure they don't argue over who gets to hoard the most gold!

All the heavy hitters like Paladins, Archers, Mages, Necromancers, and a bunch more are yours to boss around. But watch out, they might start arguing about who's the real hero of the party while the enemies sneak by!

Are you poised for the ultimate clash? Embark on an epic journey alongside the brave warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army as they unite to conquer a colossal foe.

GAME FEATURES:
Recruit 34 unique heroes and towers!

- 18 ELITE TOWERS to build and upgrade
What’s a strategy game without mighty defense towers? Seize them to clash against any enemy!

Pick between accurate Archers, lethal Paladins, and even trickful Demon Pits.


- 16 EPIC HEROES - take tower defense battles to the next level
PLAY WITH 2 HEROES SIMULTANEOUSLY!

Get ready to witness the formidable might of the most unlikely dual-heroes combinations. A forest guardian spirit and a powerful battle automaton or perhaps a space-bending mage and your average Joe.


- 6 TERRAINS with fascinating battlefields to conquer
Defend Kingdom Rush’s colorful landscapes. Clash across the realm’s deep forest, or even its dangerous caverns.


- 25 CAMPAIGN STAGES full of fast-paced td battles
Set your strategy in exotic terrains full of surprising challenges and details.

Clash against hordes of unpredictable enemies and epic boss fights to take your defense strategy to the limit!

- 3 DIFFERENT GAME MODES to test your might
Try different and more challenging ways of playing each stage after you emerge victorious. Who doesn't love a good challenge?

- 58+ GAME ACHIEVEMENTS to conquer in battle
What’s an epic strategy game without tasty rewards? Show off your skills and unlock prizes!

- 45+ DIFFERENT ENEMIES to test your tower defense wits
Show the alliance’s td battle skills with 4 different enemy clans. Beat each of them with a unique defense strategy!


- And, of course…
There are lots of easter eggs and the usual Ironhide Game Studio lighthearted humor.
Because what's a strategy game without a few hidden surprises?

name: Sonic Runners Adventure
description:
Sonic the Hedgehog and his friends are back in an action-packed runner game!
 
Catch speed fever as you relive the Sonic legend. Run, jump, dash or fly across the road and through exciting platformer levels. Unlock new characters including Tails, Knuckles and more, each with their own unique abilities you can power up. Rush to save Sonic's universe by fighting Dr. Eggman across 4 iconic locations.
 
All this in a compact download size, so just about anyone can jump-start their day with some high-speed arcade action!

SONIC FEATURES
• Dash through 4 iconic locations with super graphics. WARNING: May cause a rush of excitement. 
• Unlock loads of characters like Tails, Knuckles, Shadow the Hedgehog and more high-speed legends, each with their own super abilities.
• Overcome an endless rush of obstacles and villains, including the nefarious Dr. Eggman himself!
• Listen to iconic tracks as you run for heart-pounding fun!
• Pick up your favourite buddies, each with their own super skill! And remember: Choose them wisely to combine their skills and help you win!
• Power up your favourite characters to improve their abilities.
• An exciting story full of super characters and fun twists.
• Jump into a variety of fun arcade experiences with replayable levels & loads of objectives. Whatever road you dash down, it's guaranteed to have endless enjoyment!
• Discover the mysterious Bonus mode that's a real rush of fun with a dash of speed fever!
• Enjoy skill-based combo gameplay using simple controls, plus an auto-run mode so anyone can jump in on the action!
• You can play the game completely offline after your first session!

The perfect game for fans of high-speed platformers, offline action, fun runs, arcade legends, or "The Blue Blur," Sonic the Hedgehog himself!

name: The Sun: Origin
description:
*** Over 500 thousand downloads on devices.
*** A large post-apocalyptic world with many different quests!!!
*** Perfect crafting system!!! Assemble your power armor!!!
*** Awesome graphics at maximum settings!

An action game with RPG elements in a cruel post-apocalyptic world, a world with radiation, hunger and disease. Only a few people managed to survive in that deadly attack that hit the planet from the space, but after a short time a new catastrophe started to threaten the survivors. And the main character, the Chosen of the North-216 Community, will have to deal with it. 

World of the post-apocalypse. First person shooter for survival.

The Sun Origin: Post-apocalyptic action — is a first-person shooter with RPG elements with its own history, hundreds of tasks, a huge arsenal of weapons and armor, trade, fighting factions, mutants, bandits and prowlers. Explore the world with a huge number of locations, buy the best weapons from the merchants and improve them. You will need only the best equipment! After all, your main goal is to save your Community from hunger. And let the struggle for survival begin!!!

Brief background.

In the year 2050, the sun unleashed a catastrophic surge of energy into space, a wave of power that would plunge our civilization into chaos for centuries. Though predicted for years by the scientific community, their warnings were ignored by the world leaders that instead squabbled over petty territorial concerns.

When the wave of energy struck the earth, a storm of radioactive particles blanketed the atmosphere in a deadly, carcinogenic fog. The fog killed indiscriminately… the young, old, rich and poor all fell in equal measure. Only those that had heeded the warnings and taken shelter in abandoned bunkers were spared. 

When their supplies eventually ran out and these communities were forced to emerge from their shelters, they saw a new world of desolation and chaos. A world in which the laws of civilization had been replaced by the law of the gun. The few areas that still had clean water and arable land were held by ruthless warlords and their armies.

It was in this world that a warrior known only as Raven would emerge. A warrior that would save his people by bending the wasteland to his will. A warrior that would one day become a legend.

It's a challenge! The world of the apocalypse or you?

name: Saints Row: The Third
description:
READ BEFORE BUYING: Please expand this description and read the full list of supported devices below to confirm that your device is supported.

From scrappy street gang to their own energy drinks, clothing lines and international brand recognition, The Third Street Saints have come a long way. Now their sights are set on Steelport: a once-proud metropolis brought low by a trifecta of gangs known as the Syndicate.

Tailored to touchscreen and optimised for iOS, Saints Row: The Third Remastered is an open world of shameless excess in the palm of your hand.

YOUR CITY, YOUR RULES
Tear up the streets with tanks and hover bikes, build a portfolio of cribs and “legit” businesses, and take Steelport from the Syndicate district-by-district.

CRUSH THE COMPETITION
Win the arms race against the gun-running Morningstar, lay the smackdown on the Luchadores, and delete the Decker cyber-criminals across 47 madcap missions.

ACTION ON EVERY CORNER
Earn cash and respect by base-jumping, boosting cars, and becoming a gravity-defying insurance fraudster.

WEAPONS OF CRASS DESTRUCTION
Defeating your enemies is good. Humiliating them is so much better! Beat rivals into submission with outrageous weapons, and reinvent the drive-by with human cannonball cars and flamethrowing Genkimobiles.

IT’S IN YOUR HANDS!
The full AAA experience on the go, with customisable touchscreen controls, plus support for gamepads and mouse & keyboard.

OVER-THE-TOP CO-OP
Steelport is even more fun with homies — play the entire game online with a friend.

THE FULL PACKAGE
Saints Row: The Third Remastered comes complete with all its DLC, from Professor Genki’s murderous Genkibowl VII, sci-fi stardom in Gangstas in Space, and even weirder science in The Trouble With Clones. Also in the mix are over 30 more weapons, vehicles, and costumes.

===

Saints Row: The Third Remastered requires iOS 18 or later. You need 22.12GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.
