name: Wobbly Life
description:
Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day!  

Wobbly Life is a physics-based open-world multiplayer sandbox game where you can explore, complete jobs, earn money, drive vehicles, own houses, collect pets and embark on hilarious adventures together. 

Play with all of your friends across ANY mobile platform and explore a vibrant world packed with secrets, missions, mini-games, vehicles and surprises. If you enjoy family-friendly sandbox games, multiplayer adventures, life simulation games and open-world exploration, you’ll love Wobbly Life. 

EXPLORE A HUGE OPEN WORLD 
• Explore towns, mountains, islands, caves and hidden locations 
• Complete story missions to unlock unique rewards 
• Solve mysteries and uncover secrets across Wobbly Island 
• Train to become a Wobbly Astronaut and launch into space 

Almost everything in Wobbly Life is interactive, creating endless opportunities for exploration, experimentation and fun. 

COMPLETE JOBS & EARN MONEY 
Grandma wants you to get a job! Choose from 20+ unique jobs and earn money to unlock new content. Every job offers unique challenges, rewards and opportunities to build your Wobbly fortune. 

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER, HOUSE & VEHICLES 
 Spend your hard-earned money on exciting upgrades and unlockables. 
• Choose from 500+ clothing items 
• Collect and care for pets 
• Purchase houses ranging from small cabins to luxury mansions 
• Unlock and drive 90+ vehicles 
• Personalize your Wobbly character and lifestyle 

CHALLENGE FRIENDS & CLIMB LEADERBOARDS 
Compete against players around the world or challenge friends directly to see who can earn the highest scores, complete the most jobs and set the fastest race times. Choose from the Richest Wobbler, Job Master, Race King and Wobble Run Champion leaderboard, all available in the iOS Games Center leaderboard. 

JOIN OUR WOBBLY COMMUNITY 
Join us on Discord and check out the amazing Wobbly community! 

Download Wobbly Life today and discover one of the most fun, creative and adventure-filled multiplayer sandbox games available.

name: Northgard
description:
Northgard is a strategy game based on Norse mythology in which you control a Clan of Vikings fighting for the control of a mysterious newfound continent.

After years of tireless explorations, brave Vikings have discovered a new land filled with mystery, danger and riches: NORTHGARD.

The boldest Northmen have set sail to explore and conquer these new shores, bring fame to their Clan and write history through conquest, trading, or devotion to the Gods.

That is, if they can survive the dire Wolves and Undead Warriors roaming the land, befriend or defeat the giants, and survive the harshest winters ever witnessed in the North.

FEATURES
• Build your settlement on the newly discovered continent of Northgard
• Assign your vikings to various jobs (Farmer, Warrior, Sailor, Loremaster...)
• Manage your resources carefully and survive harsh winters and vicious foes
• Expand and discover new territory with unique strategic opportunities
• Achieve different victory conditions (Conquest, Fame, Lore, Trading...)

STORY MODE: RIG’S SAGA
The Viking High King is murdered and his Regal Horn is stolen by a man named Hagen.
This event kickstarts a saga that will take Rig, his son and heir accompanied by his right-hand man Brand through the new continent of Northgard.
The continent where he will make new friends and foes and discover a much greater threat than Hagen, and the reasons behind his father’s assassination.

MULTIPLAYER
• Play with or against other Mobile players with up to 6 players
• Includes Duel, Free for All and Teamplay modes

CHOOSE YOUR CLAN
In order to complete the 11 campaign chapters, the player will have to master the specificities of the 6 first clans and tame the unforgiving wilderness of Northgard.

More clans are joining the fight for Northgard!
• Clan of the Snake: Act from the shadows and take the lead with cunning guerilla tactics
• Clan of the Dragon: Embrace the old ways and please the gods with sacrifices
• Clan of the Kraken: Harness the bounty of the sea and unleash its brutal might
You can unlock the clans of the Snake, Dragon and Kraken separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Scale Bundle.

• Clan of the Horse: Devote yourself to the art of blacksmithing and craft powerful Relics
• Clan of the Ox: Equip ancestral equipment and prove the might of your forefathers
• Clan of the Lynx: Adopt Nature’s way and lure mythical preys into ambushes
You can unlock the Clans of the Horse, Ox and Lynx separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Fur Bundle.

• Clan of the Squirrel: Gather ingredients to prepare special recipes and survive the harsh winters
• Clan of the Rat: Embrace the way of the Shamans and work for the clan
• Clan of the Eagle: Occupy a large territory, venture outside and gather resources
Unlock the clans of the Squirrel, Rat and Eagle separately by buying the DLCs, or together with the Winter Bundle.


Carefully redesigned for mobile
• Revamped interface
• Game Center achievements
• iCloud - Share your progress between iOS devices

If you experience any issue with Northgard, please contact our customer support at support@playdigious.mail.helpshift.com and give us as much as possible information on your problem.

name: Lifeline...
description:
“[A] surprising iPhone and Apple Watch bestseller is pushing the boundaries of fiction” - boingboing.net
“This is the best game on the Apple Watch” - Time.com

Lifeline is a playable, branching story of survival against all odds. Using your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch, you will help Taylor make life or death decisions, and face the consequences together.

Acclaimed writer Dave Justus (Fables: The Wolf Among Us) weaves a gripping interactive story through the aftermath of a crash landing on an alien moon. Taylor is stranded, the rest of the crew are dead or missing, and Taylor’s communicator can only reach you.

Lifeline pioneered a new narrative experience enabled by modern devices. This story plays out in real time as Taylor works to stay alive, notifications deliver new messages throughout your day. Keep up as they come in, or catch up later when you’re free. You can even respond to Taylor directly from your Apple Watch or your iPhone lock screen, without launching into the app.

Or, dive in and jump back to earlier points in the story, and see what happens when you make a different choice. Simple actions can have a profound effect. Complete any single path to restart the story and unlock this mode.

Lifeline is a deep, immersive story of survival and perseverance, with many possible outcomes. Taylor is relying on YOU.

You can play Lifeline in any of these languages:
- English
- French
- German
- Russian
- Simplified Chinese
- Japanese
- Spanish
- Korean

NEW in version 1.8: Stick around after the game for a special story epilogue from Dave Justus. For players who have already finished the game, the Bonus Story becomes available under the game options. Witness the events leading up to Lifeline: Silent Night.

Internet connection not required. No in-app purchases and no ads.


Praise for Lifeline:

“I’ve played many games that I find engrossing, but Lifeline may be one of the first that changed the way I thought about my daily routine, which leapt off the screen and became a part of my lived experience.” - Eli Cymet, Gamezebo

“I felt an immediate attachment to a fictional character pinging me from a strange galaxy to my wearable.” - Luke Hopewell, Gizmodo Australia

“[P]laying it on the Apple Watch makes you truly feel like you’re exchanging messages with an astronaut via a futuristic transmitter.” - Michael Andronico, Tom’s Guide

“For a few brief hours I cared – really cared – about the fate of a completely fictional character. I don’t think any other game I’ve played has made me feel that way before.” - Matt Thrower, PocketGamer


Lifeline was created by:
Dave Justus
Mars Jokela
Dan Selleck
Colin Liotta
Jason Nowak
Ben “Books” Schwartz

name: Garten of Banban 3
description:
Languages available:
- English
- Spanish
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Chinese
- German
- Polish
- Turkish
- Indonesian
- French
- Italian

Embrace the horrors of Banban’s Kindergarten. Delve even deeper into the depths of the establishment that was left suspiciously empty. Try to survive the unexpected residents and continue the search for your child…

Explore further into the depths of Banban’s Kindergarten:
The depths of the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s Kindergarten turned out to be much bigger than anyone could have thought, with many floors having been built underneath the seemingly innocent Kindergarten explored in the first game. With friends being present at every turn, you have no choice but to continue delving deeper into the place in hopes of finding your child.

Turns out making friends is not that easy!
Despite the number of opportunities you have had to make friends, you still fail every time. But with you delving even deeper into the establishment, perhaps you will find more success down in the lower levels. In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are friends to be made in every corner!

name: Underground: Bunker Survival
description:
The world has fallen. You are the last hope for those knocking at your gates.

Underground is a deep bunker-management sim where every decision echoes through your food, water, power — and your people's spirits.
Build compartments across three floors, take in survivors at the airlock, keep your resources in balance, and don't let the bunker go dark.

What's waiting for you:

• A living bunker — 40+ compartment types: generator room, farm, med bay, laboratory, armory, district map, the old metro and more.
Every room works differently and demands your attention.

• Resources with consequences — power, water, food, air, parts, fuel. Run out of water and newcomers will walk right past your gates.
Overheat the generator and an accident is only a matter of time.

• People, not numbers — every resident has skills, health, stress and relationships.
Quarrels, illness, theft, panic — incidents won't wait: you have limited time to solve a problem before it gets worse.

• Arrivals at the gate — survivors keep coming to the airlock. Let them in, turn them away, or send them off with rations?
Your bunker's reputation decides who shows up tomorrow.

• Your own path — fortress, radio contact, autonomy, science, evacuation or a return to the surface.
Goals will show you where to grow next.

• The metro and recon — explore the tunnels, gather loot, trade with friends and fight off threats in the corridors.

• Mini-games that matter — harvest crops, repair equipment, calm a panic: quick games earn resources and change how events end.

• Friends in the game — add friends, meet their survivors at your gates, exchange resources and earn bonuses for playing together.

• Play at your own pace — minimize the app and time in the bunker stops. Come back and pick up right where you left off.

Who this game is for:
If you love Fallout Shelter, This War of Mine, or management games with personality — this one is full of "what if I try it this way?" moments. Not a five-minute arcade, but a bunker that grows with you.

Download. Open the airlock. Decide who gets in first.

name: Shotgun King
description:
Chess, but all your army has gone over to the white side, leaving you with nothing but your royal shotgun and your wounded pride. Carried by your dark folly, you decide it's time to teach those white pieces to fear the Shotgun King.

Every turn, you may either move your king or shoot at enemy pieces, after what you'll need to move again to reload your shotgun. Avoid checkmate and kill the enemy king to complete the floor. After each floor, you may choose between two random combinations of one upgrade for you and one upgrade for the other side. Choose wisely and keep on winning floors and you just may get your kingdom back.

Runs may take ~20 minutes to complete. The game features 15 ranks of difficulty, unlockable cards, over 100 achievements to complete, an endless mode, and now a chase mode where you get continually assailed from all sides!

name: StreetPro Racing
description:
StreetPro invites you to a realistic and exciting driving experience. This game offers 30+ different vehicles and 10+ large maps, allowing you to enjoy all types of driving. The variety of maps gives you various options to test your driving skills and have fun.

Maps and Missions:
StreetPro features 10+ maps, each offering different experiences. One of the maps offers a comprehensive vehicle test track. Here you can test your car's performance with suspension tests, slalom and drift courses. The other maps are designed for free roaming, drifting and speeding. You can drive through different areas such as cities and highways, explore freely and reach high speeds. There is also a mission track with 20 levels, full of various challenges and missions.

Vehicle Features:
Vehicles in StreetPro are highly interactive and realistic. Each vehicle has 4 windows and 4 doors that can be opened. You can get out of the vehicle and walk around, open the doors and get in. Vehicles also have detailed interiors; the turn signal lever moves when signaled, gas and brake pedals work realistically. All functions such as wipers, lights, quads and signals work like the real thing. The time slowdown mode makes your driving experience even more enjoyable.

Drift and Modification:
Drift mode offers a realistic and fun drifting experience. There are many options for vehicle modification, from color changes to license plate, from neon lights to headlight light color. The steering wheel, seats, suspension settings and rims can also be changed. Interior decoration options can include various objects such as chicks, spiders, turtles, iguanas and birds. It is also possible to add a computer and game console to the right front seat. You can customize the exterior of your vehicle, such as additional lights and spoilers.

StreetPro is the perfect game to improve your driving skills, customize vehicles and enjoy a realistic driving experience. Realistic graphics, detailed in-car functions and a wide range of modification options take your driving experience to the next level. With fun missions, free roaming areas and impressive drifting features, StreetPro gives you an unforgettable driving experience.

name: Shadow Knight Ninja Fight Game
description:
Challenge your skill with new mode & new boss!!!

Harmonia used to be a bright world of all races, where Human, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man and Elf live in peace together. One day, when deep desires arose, the dark forces ascended from hell, invading the world, that tragedy struck every Harmonia citizen and made everything sink to the depths of despair.

Play the role of Noah - a Shadow Knight, you need to make your way through the hell gate, fight evil enemies, defeat the immortals of Darkness and bring back the light to Harmonia. You will find Ashley and Lucius - your companions on the journey saving Harmonia!

Download and Join the fight now!

GAME FEATURES:

▶ The True Feeling of an Action RPG Game
Experience the action RPG game feeling with hack and slash gameplay in the dark fantasy world setting. There are 10 maps from The Stream City, Shadow Forest to Capitals of The Mortals, and they are still updated. 

▶ Watch out the monsters and bosses!
With the absence of light, evil reveals its true form. 
Monsters in each place have different shapes, skills, and stories behind them. Sometimes you have to take them down even when you're the weaker. Beware of skeletons, elves that can control your body and your mind, be sure to use skills with the right combo, dodge their attack wisely. 

Bosses have their stories as well. They are giant Kings of the dark lands with sturdy physique, robust strength, and particular abilities. Facing them requires more than just powerful stats. 

▶ Fight with multiple choices
Fight the way you want as you can choose your own unique heroes, determine your favorite fighting style among slashing a big sword, shooting slugs, or piercing invisible spears. In each match, you can pick 2 characters to play and they can be readily switched. 

Keep in mind that Each hero can knock the enemy up, knockdown, toss back,...
Dodging smoothly, controlling enemies effectively, and using skills combo calmly is the key to win every battle

▶ Embark on a horrid but fascinating adventure!

Not only you, we also get bored with the limit of horizontal gameplay only mode. 
In Shadow Knight, you will go on a journey with different terrains by running, climbing, jumping, where you will confront more danger, further difficulty, and additionally have chances to get more rewards in return as we put some easter eggs and hidden rewards along the way. 

▶ Interact with others and show the world your skills

You will be immersed in endless dark fantasy shadow battles. Besides towns, forests, dungeons, as an online game, you can interact with others unlimitedly, engage in endless battles with tremendously competitive and merciless battlefields such as Survival, World Boss, PVP Arena,... These features will be available soon!

▶ Gear Up In Style
Collect the best weapon, equipment, rune from hundreds of items, then fully customize your Shadow Knight to stand out from other knights. Join the adventure and create the craziest combats 'cause Your Knight, Your Style! 

▶ Easy In Upgrading
While you're away, your knights are still being trained and collecting resources to upgrade. When you're back, they will be stronger, gain new levels, learn new skills. Grow and train a powerful team and ready for battles!

ACE THE SHADOW!

* Follow us on social media for more information and get support:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnight.Official
Email: shadowknight@fansipan.hk 

* Notice:
Shadow Knight is an online game and requires a stable internet connection.

name: EvoCreo2 Catch & Tame Monsters
description:
Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game
Begin your role playing game (RPG) journey as a new recruit in the Shoru Police Academy. Creo Monsters are disappearing, and it's your mission to uncover the truth behind these mysterious events. But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Along the way, assist the citizens of Shoru by completing over 50 engaging missions, building alliances, and discovering hidden treasures.

Capture and Train Over 300 Monsters
Love monster-collecting games? Build your RPG dream team of Creo in this open-world role playing game. Hunt rare and legendary monsters, each available in unique alternate colors. With over 300 unique monsters to capture, evolve, and train, you’ll have endless possibilities to customize your strategy in pocket monster games. Create powerful combinations and lead your Creo to victory in thrilling turn-based battles.

Explore this monster adventure game
Experience more than 30 hours of offline and online rpg gameplay as you dive into a richly detailed open world. From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter
Prepare for trainer battles with a highly customizable system. Equip your Creo with items and unlock over 100 unique traits to enhance their abilities. Train your Creo to learn and master over 200 moves, which you can swap anytime to adapt to new challenges. Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Master Trainer
Challenge the strongest monster trainers across Shoru and rise through the ranks in this paid role playing game. Compete in the prestigious Coliseum, where only the best monster trainers are crowned as champions. Will you conquer every rpg battle and claim the title of Evoking Master Trainer?

Key Features:
- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide
- 300+ collectible monsters to capture, train, and evolve.
- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

Join the adventure today and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate monster trainer in EvoCreo 2! Can you catch them all and master the secrets of the Creo?

name: Aces of the Luftwaffe
description:
YOU have to show what you’re made of as the war over Europe is in full swing. Fight waves of Axis planes and panzers until you hit the boss enemies – the ACES OF THE LUFTWAFFE.

STORY
It is the darkest hour for England. The Axis are sending their best into the Battle of Britain, and only a handful of brave pilots are left to destroy them. Get into your war plane and don’t let go of the trigger before each and every enemy has been blown out of the skies! But even if you vanquish the notorious Aces of the Luftwaffe, are you prepared to take the fight to the mainland?

Will YOU foil the occult plans of the Luftwaffe to spread darkness over England?

FEATURES
- PLAY WITHOUT ADS!
- Fight thousands of enemy air planes
- Choose and upgrade your plane and pilot
- Beat super tough bosses
- Fly bombastic missions
- Enjoy mighty power-ups
- Full tablet support
- MFi game controller support
- Game Center support

Thank you for playing 'Aces of the Luftwaffe'!

name: Free Fire India
description:
Ninjas unite. The Nine Tails is back!

The classic collaboration returns with the Hidden Leaf Village, Ninjutsu Scrolls, Reanimation Revival Points, and more, plus new gameplay, ninjutsu, and locations!

[Nine Tails Strikes & Sharingan: Control]
While players are on the plane, the Nine Tails can trigger random events such as forced parachute jumps, Arsenal openings, and supply drops. Capture Sharingan: Control to direct a Tailed Beast Bomb at any target area!

[Ninjutsu Scrolls Return]
Fireball Jutsu, Water Dragon Jutsu, Chidori, Rasengan, and more are back. Try the new 8 Trigrams Palm Rotation to repel nearby enemies and block incoming shots with a spinning chakra defense.

[Explore the New Ninja Academy]
The Hidden Leaf Village returns alongside the new Ninja Academy. Take a seat on the nostalgic swing at the school gate to relive iconic anime moments. Interact with it to get a buff!

[Ninjas Unite Against the Nine Tails]
Complete tasks to collect event tokens and unlock ninjas and their exclusive combo skills. Defend against the Nine Tails alongside them, and choose either the Jiraiya Bundle or Hinata Bundle as your grand prize!


Free Fire India is a world-famous survival shooter game available on mobile. Each 10-minute game places you on a remote island where you are pit against 49 other players, all seeking survival. Players freely choose their starting point with their parachute, and aim to stay in the safe zone for as long as possible. Drive vehicles to explore the vast map, hide in the wild, or become invisible by proning under grass or rifts. Ambush, snipe, survive, there is only one goal: to survive and answer the call of duty.
Free Fire India, Battle In Style!

[Survival shooter in its original form]
Search for weapons, stay in the play zone, loot your enemies and become the last man standing. Along the way, go for legendary airdrops while avoiding airstrikes to gain that little edge against other players.

[10 minutes, 50 players, epic survival goodness awaits]
Fast and Lite gameplay - Within 10 minutes, a new survivor will emerge. Will you go beyond the call of duty and be the one under the shining lite?

[4-man squad, with in-game voice chat]
Create squads of up to 4 players and establish communication with your squad at the very first moment. Answer the call of duty and lead your friends to victory and be the last team standing at the apex.

[Clash Squad]
A fast paced 4v4 game mode! Manage your economy, purchase weapons, and defeat the enemy squad!

[Realistic and smooth graphics]
Easy to use controls and smooth graphics promises the optimum survival experience you will find on mobile to help you immortalize your name among the legends.


[Contact us]
Customer Service: https://support-freefireind.garena.com/ind

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Block Out! - Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Get ready for Block Out!, a block puzzle game where every level feels alive. Slide colorful blocks, match them with their targets while experiencing the unique twist of moving elevators and block generators. Each puzzle feels fresh with ever-changing layouts. Plan your moves, think quickly, and enjoy the satisfaction of perfect clears as you progress through a colorful and evolving puzzle adventure. Block Out! offers a puzzle experience that keeps you coming back for more. Accept the challenge and start your journey! 

Quick Play Guide
- Start Simple: Slide the blocks to the matching doors and create satisfying clears.
- Plan Ahead: Position blocks carefully, manage space, and keep up with dynamic challenges. 
- Think Fast: Move faster to complete levels and unlock new challenges.

Cool Features
- Offline Play: Enjoy anywhere, anytime—no wi-fi required.
- Strategic Gameplay: Start simple, think twice. Plan your moves and experience the satisfaction of clearing each puzzle.
- Dynamic Obstacles:  Block generators, moving elevators, and other elements bring variety and spice to every level.
- Colorful Visuals: Bright and gorgeous design makes every puzzle a joy to solve.

Block Out! is designed for puzzle lovers who enjoy both strategy and action. Download Block Out! now and explore the dynamic world of colorful puzzles.

name: Magic Sort!
description:
Discover Magic Sort! Mix colors in a world where every splash of water is a step into mystery. This isn’t just a game; it’s a journey through puzzles that sparkle with charm, inviting you to sort, match, and puzzle your way through.

Quick Play Guide

- Start Simple: Tap a bottle to pick it up, and another to pour the water. Organize the water so each bottle has only one color.
- Think Ahead: Pour water only if it matches the top color of the destination bottle and there’s room. Plan to avoid dead ends and strategically sort the colors.
- Embrace Complexity: With each level, sorting and matching require more thought. Every move is crucial.
- Utilize Magic Tools: Stuck? Use 'Undo' to reverse moves, or 'Shuffle' to rearrange the bottles anew, making sorting a breeze.

Cool Features

- Spellbinding Levels: Each stage brings a fresh challenge of color sorting and magical fun.
- Wizard’s Gear: Magic tools make your quest of water sorting smoother and way more fun.
- Vivid Splashes: A riot of colors makes every move a delight, turning sorting into a visual feast.
- Unique Twists: Classic puzzles get a magical makeover for extra thrill, blending color, water, and puzzle elements seamlessly.
- Boosts & Surprises: Stir up boosts in the cauldron to power through puzzles, adding a layer of strategy to your color sorting.
- Mystical Ingredients: Gather ingredients to brew stronger magic, enhancing your water sort adventures.

Why Play Magic Sort?

- Sharpen Your Brain: Each puzzle is a fun test of wits, blending elements of color, water, and sorting into each challenge.
- Chill Vibes: Dive into a soothing, colorful escape, where water and color sorting provide a tranquil experience.
- Magic at Every Turn: New potions and surprises make every level an adventure in water, color, and puzzle-solving.

Get Ready to Cast Some Color!

name: Ludo King

1 Billion Downloads!

* New Quick Ludo Mode available

Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Kulfi: Games for Couples
description:
You talk to them every day. And still, by 10pm, you're both just trading reels and typing "kya kar rahe ho" for the ninth time. You're not fighting. You're not bored of each other. You're just out of things to do.

Nobody warns you about this part of loving someone in India. A lot of us don't share a city, forget a room. The whole relationship lives inside a phone. Two grey ticks, a few voice notes, one call before bed. So much love stuck inside a very small screen.

Three of us built Kulfi, and we were all in the same spot. Long-term partners we love, who make our day. But once the day's been talked through, it all starts to repeat. What we missed wasn't the conversation, it was their presence. We didn't want to sit alone at night scrolling Instagram. We wanted to be in the same room as them, even when we couldn't. Half our video calls were just silence, nothing left to say. And it wasn't only us. Almost everyone we knew was in the same quiet.

Here's the only promise we care about: no couple on Kulfi should have a boring conversation again. We take that dead late-night chat and turn it into banter, teasing, a bit of fighting, and a lot of "wait, that's not fair."

Kulfi doesn't work like anything you've played. The games run across two phones, yours and theirs, at once. Some split the controls between you, so it's one game, one boat, each holding one half. Mess up your side and you both go down together.

Here's the part we love most. It's made for when you're already on a call. Put Kulfi on while you're on a video or audio call at night, and play straight through it. You're on the call anyway. This is what you do during it.

One house rule. No singles allowed. You invite your partner, send them a code, they punch it in, and you're paired. Till then, the games stay locked. Sounds a bit harsh, but that's the point. Kulfi is a two-person club, and if you're inside it, you've already got the one thing it asks for.

And you won't run dry. We add fresh games every single week. That's a founder promise, not a marketing line. We're trying to keep our own partners entertained, so trust me, the new stuff keeps coming.

Here's some of what's inside:

Pirate Escape
One boat, two captains. One wrong tap and you're both underwater. Stay in sync, or sink.

Snatch the Fries
The plate's between you and there was never enough. Grab fast. Love is conditional now.

Yeet the Spider
Aim, hold your nerve, fling it before the music stops. Don't ask, just throw.

Basketball Rivalry
Twenty seconds on the clock, zero mercy. Outscore them, or hear about it all night.

Four in a Row
Looks innocent. Ends relationships. Drop your coin, block theirs, act like you planned it.

Never Have I Ever
The cards ask, you answer honestly. Some answers you'll wish you could take back.

Who's More Likely To
You each lock in a guess. Then the reveal. Then the argument that lasts an hour.

Pillow Talk
The soft one. A quiet prompt, a real answer, the kind of 2am talk you don't get over text.


Underneath all of it, there's Roadtrip. The more you play, the more miles you and your partner rack up, and your little car moves further across the map. You unlock new cities, crack clues for what's next, and slowly take the road trip you keep saying you'll go on someday. Every other Kulfi couple is on that road too. You can't always meet. You can still go somewhere together.
One honest thing. Nearly every app you live on, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, was built somewhere else. India has over 200 million couples, and Kulfi is the couples app built in India, for India. We want it in the hands of every couple in the country.

So that's our ask. We built this to solve our own problem and sweated every detail. Download it, play it, and tell us honestly what's broken and what you loved. And please, spread the word. We're a young company, every download counts, and the fastest way Kulfi reaches the couple who needs it is you.

See you on the road,
The founders of Kulfi

name: Arrow Puzzle - Arrows Game
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

- In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
- Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
- Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.
- Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
- If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
- Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

• A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
• Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
• Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
• Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
• No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
• Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

name: Telegram Messenger
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

What’s New in YONO?

· A minimalist, high-speed UI/UX for effortless navigation and one-tap access to your most-used features.
· Complete e-KYC or update the personal details feature for instant support without visiting a branch.
· Monitor your financial health and use our new simulator to see how your actions impact your credit score.
· Receive offers, investment tips, and spend analysis tailored specifically to your lifestyle and financial goals.

Instant Banking and Onboarding

· Open a Savings Account Instantly: Use Video KYC for paperless account opening with immediate activation.
· Instant Account Funding: Fund your new account the moment it’s active and start transacting right away.
· YONO Cash: Experience cardless ATM withdrawals at over 20,000+ SBI ATMs across India.

Seamless Payments and Transfer

· Enhanced UPI Experience: Lightning-fast UPI payments. Scan any QR, pay via phone number, or manage your UPI Lite for small-value transactions without a PIN.
· UPI for Everyone: Make fast, secure money transfers with SBI UPI. No SBI account required.
· Smart Bill Payments: Effortlessly pay electricity, water, gas, and broadband bills. Set up Autopay & reminders to avoid late fees.
· Global remittances: Securely send money across borders at competitive forex rates with real-time tracking.

Investments and Loans

· Mutual Fund Hub: Manage your portfolio, start a new SIP, or explore top-rated funds directly from the app.
· Instant Loans: Apply for pre-approved Personal Loans, Car Loans, or the new Insta Home Top-Up Loan with zero paperwork.
· Smart Deposits: Open Fixed Deposits (FD) or Recurring Deposits (RD) with a single tap and view your accrued interest in real-time.
· NPS & PPF Management: Secure your retirement by managing your National Pension System (NPS) and Public Provident Fund (PPF) accounts seamlessly.

Shopping, Travel, and Lifestyle

· YONO Marketplace: Exclusive deals from India’s top brands in electronics, fashion, & home decor.
· Travel Companion: Book flights, hotels, with integrated rewards.
· Loyalty Points: Earn & redeem SBI Rewardz points across a massive catalogue of products and gift vouchers.

Security and Control

· Digital Lock/Unlock: Instantly lock or unlock your debit card, manage international usage, and set transaction limits for safety.
· Advanced Biometrics: Log in securely using FaceID or TouchID.
· 24/7 Support: Access YONO customer care directly from the app or raise complaints and track them in real-time.

More Ways to Bank

• Passbook & Statements: Access your account passbook & download transaction statements whenever you need them.
• Quick Pay: Transfer funds up to prescribed limits to beneficiaries without adding them first, making urgent payments faster and simpler.
• Service on the Go: Request cheque books, update personal details, track service requests, and access important banking services directly from the app.
• Personalised Insights: Gain a clearer understanding of your spending habits with smart analytics and recommendations designed to help you manage money better.

YONO SBI isn't just an app - it's financial freedom. From first accounts to mutual funds and deposits, one personalised journey for every Indian.

Key Technical Details

· Optimised for iOS 17.0 and above
· Available in English, Hindi & 11 more languages.
· Your financial data is protected by industry-leading end-to-end encryption.

Download the all-new YONO SBI today and discover why "You Only Need One."

name: RailOne
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion. 

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

RBL MoBank is now RBL MyBank – a smarter, faster and more secure way to bank anytime, anywhere.
 
With a brand-new look and improved features, RBL MyBank offers a seamless mobile banking experience to manage your RBL Bank account, send money, pay bills, and more - all from your smartphone.
 
Key Features:
 
•  Easy Login & Security 
Login securely with MPIN, fingerprint or Face ID. Enjoy peace of mind with enhanced encryption and multi-layer security. In case of loss, switch off your debit card for security purpose.
 
•  Account Overview 
Check your savings or current account balance, view mini statements, and monitor your transactions in real-time.
 
•  Instant Fund Transfers 
Send and receive money using IMPS, NEFT, RTGS or UPI with just a few taps.
 
•  UPI Payments 
Create and manage your RBL UPI ID to pay anyone, anytime. Scan QR codes, make merchant payments, and more.
 
•  Bill Payments & Recharges 
Recharge your mobile/DTH and pay electricity, gas, broadband and other utility bills instantly.
 
•  Credit Card Management 
Apply and view your RBL Bank credit card details, pay bills, check rewards, and manage limits easily.
 
•  Fixed & Recurring Deposits 
Open and manage FDs or RDs directly from the app.
 
•  Request Cheque Book & Manage Services 
Apply for a cheque book, stop cheques, block cards, and update personal details in just a few steps.
 
•  Loan Services 
Easily apply for loans, monitor your loan status, and manage EMIs directly within the app.
 
•  Investments 
Buy and redeem mutual funds effortlessly and stay updated on your investment portfolio.
 
•  Customer Support 
Access one-touch calling to our contact centre from the pre-login screen. Once logged in, you can request a callback, and our team will reach out to you promptly.
 
•  Personalized Offers 
Receive tailored offers, delivered through smart, contextual marketing.
 
What’s New in the MyBank App?
 
Enhanced User Experience 
•   Continuous vertical scroll-based screens for effortless navigation. 
•   Get a consolidated view of your account balances, fixed/recurring deposits, credit card bills, and utility bills—all in one dashboard.
 
Personalized Dashboards 
•   Product-wise customized dashboards for accounts, credit cards, loans & deposits 
•   Custom bottom navigation bars for each product category 
•   Segment-wise themes for Insignia, Signature, Aspire & Mass users
 
Smart Features for Seamless Banking 
•   Customised Dynamic bottom navigation bar  
 
Engaging & Informative Elements 
•   Ticker on the pre-login page for important customer communications 
•   Demo video & tutorial section for a guided banking experience
 
Permissions: 
•   Location permissions are necessary to determine your current location to display nearby RBL Bank branches/ATMs 
•   Application is available only in English language.  

Disclosures: 
•   A qualified Bank account with registered mobile number is required to access RBL MyBank.  

This is the latest version of the app.  

Download the RBL MyBank app now and experience the smarter way to bank!
 
Existing RBL MoBank users can log in using the same credentials.

DRIVE AND EXPLORE

The game includes rewarded video ads. Some activities, video publishing and temporary vehicle access involve watching an ad. Completed challenges can offer an ad to double the coin reward. Ludo King is a cross platform multiplayer game that supports Desktop, Android, iOS, HTML5 and Windows mobile platform at same time. Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Pachisi. A Ludo game which was played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the Ludo dice and move your tokens to reach the center of the Ludo board. Beat other players, become the Ludo King.

Ludo King follows the traditional rules and the old school look of the Ludo game. Just like the kings and queens of India's golden age, your fate depends on the roll of the Ludo's dice and your strategy of moving the tokens effectively. 

Features of Ludo King:
* No internet connection required! Play against the computer
* Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer

Ludo King is a friends and family game that was once played by kings and now it can be enjoyed by you and your family and friends. You'll be playing this Ludo for hours and its fun for the whole family.

Ludo King is a perfect time pass game of Ludo board game. You played Ludo in your childhood, now play on your phone and tablet.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Like Ludo, you may have played this board game when you were young. Ludo King now incorporates this classic Snakes and Ladders game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you have to be the first one to make it to 100. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King. 

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). name: Arrow Puzzle: Tap Puzzle Games
summary: Tap away arrows to escape the maze. Train your brain with smart puzzle games!
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a single-player logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board on every level. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting single-player arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Inspired by abstract graphic games, each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others. Clean visuals inspired by abstract graphic games help you focus on every move.

स्टाइलिश टॉप, पैंट, खूबसूरत ड्रेसेस और पार्टी गाउन को मिक्स और मैच करें।

name: AadhaarFaceRD
summary: UIDAI Face Authentication App
description:
This application is designed to function as a headless app, meaning it cannot be opened directly from the Play Store or your device's app drawer, nor will you find an application icon in your app drawer. It works in collaboration with the Aadhaar Authentication User Agency (AUA), the KYC User Agency (KUA), and other entities.

How the Application Works:
Since the application is headless, there is no option to open it directly from your device. Instead, it is invoked by an AUA or KUA that you are interacting with. When you need to authenticate your identity, the AUA/KUA will trigger the FaceRD application to perform the necessary operations. This design ensures that your interactions with the app are seamless and secure, without requiring you to manually open or interact with the app itself.

Security and Privacy:
This design choice prioritizes your security by minimizing the points of direct interaction and potential vulnerabilities. By being triggered only by authorized agencies, the application reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: RailOne
summary: An All-in-one App by Indian Railways consolidating public-facing services.
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion.

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

RailOne is available for download on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, ensuring accessibility for both Android and iOS users.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

👉Are CRIF & Experian credit scores different from CIBIL?
CRIF, Experian & CIBIL are different platforms owned by different credit information companies. However, all 3 companies are approved by the Reserve Bank of India.

The parameters chosen by CIBIL TransUnion, Experian & CRIF High Mark are majorly similar. All 3 companies have a similar mechanism to calculate the credit score. They use repayment history, credit mix, new credit and outstanding debt to make the credit report. Having a good credit history in CIBIL will have somewhat similar results with CRIF High Mark and Experian as well.

UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is envisaged to make e-governance 'mobile first'. It is an evolving platform designed for citizens of India to offer them access to the pan-India e-Gov services from the Central, State, Local Bodies, and Agencies of government on app, web, SMS, and IVR channels.
 
Key Features:
- Unified Platform: It brings together all government departments and their services on a single platform to provide better and easier services to citizens.
- Mobile First Strategy: It aligns all government services with the mobile first strategy to leverage mobile adoption trends.    
- Integration with Digital India Services: It provides seamless integration with other Digital India Services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and PayGov. Any new such service will automatically be integrated with the platform.
- Uniform Experience: It is designed to enable citizens to discover, download, access, and use all government services easily.
- Secure and Scalable: It supports Aadhaar-based and other authentication mechanisms for service access. The sensitive profile data is saved in an encrypted format and no one can view this information.               
 
Key Services:
UMANG provides easy access to a plethora of Indian government services ranging from – Healthcare, Finance, Education, Housing, Energy, Agriculture, Transport to even Utility and Employment and Skills.
 
Key Benefits for Citizens:
- Single-Point Ubiquitous Access: All government services are available for citizens on a unified platform for easy access through multiple online and offline channels (SMS, email, app, and web).      
- More for Less: Only a single mobile app needs to be installed instead of each app of each department.
- Convenience: Citizens do not even need to install or update the app again to avail government services if more services are added to the platform.
- Saving of Time and Money: Citizens can anytime and anywhere avail these services through their mobile phones, desktops, and laptops without any need for visiting the department office and standing in queues.
- Uniform Experience: All the government services including payment-based transactions provide secure and uniform experience.

description:
Castle Busters is a PvP battle game where you build your castle, draft your units, and smash your opponent's castle to pieces. Blast through destructible walls and leave their plans in rubble!

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.

In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart one shot at a time. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes a rival. Who needs a front door anyway?

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Smash through walls and bring down their towers. 

⚡ Turn-based 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions. Make every shot count because your rival gets the next one.

🏗️ Your castle. Your design. Build a castle worth showing off, then put it to the test against other players. Building yours is almost as satisfying as watching theirs collapse. 

🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft your units: brave knights, sharp-eyed archers and bombers who brought more than enough explosives. Combine their strengths, find powerful synergies, and leave your opponent shaking more than their towers.

📈 Upgrades that make a difference. Level up your units and strengthen your castle with new gadgets. Give your crew a stronger home and your opponent a harder job.

🏆 Battle through the arenas. Earn trophies, progress along Trophy Road, and unlock Ranked mode. Battle real players and climb the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

🎯 Play your way. Pick off exposed units with precision or lay siege to their castle. Change your strategy as the walls come down and decide where the next shot will hurt most.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target. Destroy their defenses to open up your next shot, expose their units, and make their castle collapse. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

Win by wiping out all enemy units or turning their castle into rubble. Every turn brings a choice: take out a hero or give their castle a window they didn't ask for.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match units to build a loadout where their abilities work together. Plan around your favorites, experiment with different combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your units, unlock new heroes, and discover fresh tactical options as your crew grows. Your castle evolves too. Strengthen your walls and towers, try new gadgets and strategies, and put your build to the test in multiplayer PvP.

Progress through the arenas on Trophy Road, then climb the ranked ladder and clash with the best. You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you love turn-based strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, or fast online multiplayer battles, Castle Busters is built for you. Got a few minutes? That's plenty of time to make a mess of someone's castle. With physics-based artillery and walls that won't stay where you left them, it's impossible to play the same way twice.

The arena is open. Go break something.

FREE TO PLAY

Soar to New Heights

name: Palmon: Survival
summary: Capture, Fight, and Farm
description:
Welcome to our monster-catching survival and crafting simulation game. Embark on an epic adventure in a world filled with mysterious and powerful creatures known as Palmon!


[Capture and fight]
Capture different Palmon and discover their hidden abilities. Beware—rare Palmon offer greater rewards, but also pose a greater threat. Are you ready to take on fantastic challenges and become the ultimate Palmon master?


[Build your own homestead]
Collect Palmon and harness their powers to start fires, generate electricity, cultivate bountiful farmland, build advanced factories, and try more. Create your own thriving homestead with these extraordinary creatures by your side.


[Explore and survive]
Tame Palmon to explore the mysterious and desolate land of Pallantis. Survive against poachers and the forces of evil as you uncover secrets and navigate the thrilling mysteries and opportunities of this world.

name: Tiles Survive!
summary: Casual strategy, real survival. Power your way to victory!
description:
Enter the world of "Tiles Survive!" and guide your team of survivors through a harsh wilderness. As the core of your survivor team, explore the wild, gather key resources, and use them wisely to strengthen your shelter.
Venture into different tiles and expand your territory. Improve how you manage resources, build and upgrade structures, and connect electricity to speed up production. Create a self-sufficient shelter where every decision shapes your survivors’ future.

Game Features:

● Operations & Management
Enhance your production structures for smoother workflows. Use electricity to run your shelter more efficiently. Unlock and upgrade more structures to meet your growing needs.

● Assign Survivors
Assign jobs to your survivors, like hunters, chefs, or lumberjacks. Pay attention to their health and morale to keep productivity high.

● Resource Collection
Explore further and discover unique resources in different biomes. Gather and use every resource to your advantage.

● Multi-map & Collectibles
Travel through multiple maps to find loot and special items. Bring them back to decorate and improve your shelter.

● Recruit Heroes
Find heroes with special skills and traits who boost your shelter’s capabilities.

● Form Alliances
Team up with friends to stand against common threats, such as severe weather and wild creatures.

In "Tiles Survive!", every choice matters. How you manage resources, plan your shelter, and explore the unknown will decide your fate. Are you ready to face the challenge and thrive in the wild? Download now and begin your epic adventure!

name: Brawl Stars
summary: Bring the action! Brawl for the glory in multiplayer battle royale games.
description:
Fast paced 3v3 & 5v5 MOBA and Battle Royale made for mobile! Play online with friends or solo across a variety of PvP arena game modes in under three minutes.

Unlock and upgrade dozens of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Collect unique skins to stand out and show off. Battle in a variety of mysterious arena locations within the MOBA Brawliverse!

Brawl Stars is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Battle in multiple game modes

Gem Grab (3v3,5v5): Team up for real time 3v3 and 5v5 MOBA arena PvP battles against online players from across the world. Team up to battle and out strategize the opposing team. Collect and hold 10 gems to win, but get fragged and lose your gems.

Showdown (solo/duo): A MOBA battle royale style fight for survival. Collect power ups for your Brawler. Grab a friend or play solo, be the last Brawler standing in the rowdiest MOBA PvP battle royale yet. Winner takes it all!

Brawl Ball (3v3,5v5): It's a whole new brawl game! Show off your soccer/football skills and score two goals before the other team. There are no red cards here.

Bounty (3v3,5v5): Battle to take out opponents and earn stars, but don’t let them pick you off. The squad with the most stars wins the match!

Heist (3v3,5v5): Protect your team’s safety and try to crack open your opponents’. Navigate the arena to sneak, blast, battle and blow your way clear to the enemies treasure.

Special MOBA Events: Limited time special MOBA PvE and PvP arena battle game modes.

Championship Challenge: Join Brawl Stars' esports scene with in-game qualifiers!

Unlock and upgrade Brawlers

Collect and upgrade a variety of Brawlers with powerful super abilities, star powers and gadgets! Level them up and collect unique skin.
A fast paced battle royale MOBA made for mobile. Unlock and collect new, powerful "brawlers", each with a signature attack and super ability.

Brawl Pass

Complete quests, open Brawl Boxes, earn Gems, pins and an exclusive Brawl Pass skin! Fresh content every season.

Become the star players

Battle to climb the local and regional PvP leaderboards to prove you’re the greatest MOBA brawler of them all! Join or start your own MOBA club with fellow players online to share tips and battle together. Climb to the top of the PvP leaderboards in global and local rankings.

Constantly evolving MOBA

Look out for new "brawlers", skins, maps, special events and game modes in the future. Customize Brawlers with unlockable skins. Enjoy PVP battles solo or with friends online.
New PVP and PVE events and game modes daily. Player designed maps offer challenging new terrain to master.

name: Puzzles & Chaos: Frozen Castle
summary: Banish the cold by winning match-3 battles.
description:
Puzzles & Chaos is a match-3 fantasy strategy game that tells an ancient legend of a Frozen Land.

A once prosperous continent now lies frozen due to the bizarre magic of the undead.
The humans, dragons, and other magical creatures who once lived here perished, escaped, or were displaced to desolate lands.
As a warrior, you are expected to remove the frozen seal, awaken the dragon, and rebuild your homeland using your innate strategic talents.

1. Match-3 Battles:
Remember! Matching is the key!
Match magic tiles to release hero skills.
2. Explore the Unknown:

Customize the layout of your castle as you wish.
Buildings can be placed anywhere you want!
5. Unite With Allies: 
Cooperation enhances the fun!
By creating or joining an alliance, you will be able to rally against foes and share resources with your allies.

How can there be no dragons in a magical world?
Put the unfathomable power of the dragon at your disposal! Claim your own Dragon's Egg today!

Command your warship in epic online sea battles. Try this advanced army simulator and get your adrenaline pumping!

Beautiful and realistic
