name: Total Battle: Strategy Games
summary: Conquer kingdoms and lead heroes to victory in strategic war battles!
description:
Are you ready for epic battles?

Total Battle is free to download and play, however, it contains in-app purchases, including random-item purchases.

Build your empire and prepare for war with Total Battle, a multiplayer war strategy game that pits you against enemy factions across ancient civilizations, magic kingdoms and great empires.

Become immersed in your own world while battling for glory. Enjoy this multiplayer online strategy building game and show off your castle defense skills and tactical war strategies. Command and conquer kingdoms and castles, occupy forts, and feel the rush in this fantasy MMO RTS 4X game.

Battle alongside legendary heroes who’ll defend their territory at all costs and wage war against monsters, barbarians, wizards, elves, and other foes. Build a base and establish a strong tower defense strategy to win all the king’s battles in this medieval strategy war game and become the Lord of all the Kingdoms!

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE & DEFEND YOURSELF IN TIMES OF WAR
● Build a base for your military, which lies at the heart of your castle

● Summon the best captains to lead your warriors and achieve victory

● Strategy games require you to make the right choices for managing the troops in your army—each unit has unique abilities for going to war against monsters and other players
● Dozens of types of magic enemies of different levels


WAR STRATEGY GAMES & MULTIPLAYER BATTLES
● An MMO 4X real-time strategy game with PvE and PvP modes
● A massive open world with hundreds of kingdoms and millions of lords' castles
● Play alongside dozens of legendary heroes and captains from different civilizations online
● Find unique points of interest on the world map among deserts, forests, and mountain ranges
● Battle through hordes of enemies, abandoned gold mines, battle arenas, and ancient crypts filled with treasure that are just waiting to be discovered! 
● Not every strategy will win you a war! Dedication, careful planning, and good management will. Build a strong empire and raise a civilization
● Compete in regular competitions and challenges, putting your skills to the test

RPG MECHANICS TO BOLSTER YOUR ARMY
● Enhance your tactics with an RPG-style character leveling system
● Your heroes and captains have various skills for dealing with different situations. 
● Craft equipment and level up your heroes just like in the best MMORPGs. 
● Put your heroes at the head of your legion of troops, earn XP, and win wars!

CALL ON YOUR DRAGON
● Accept the challenge of epic monsters and raise your dragon 
● Give him a name and summon him to fight against your most dangerous enemies 
● The strength of your dragon will be indispensable when besieging mighty magical citadels

BATTLE ONLINE & JOIN CLANS
● Battle and play online with different clans
● Play with users from all over the world and fight for battle glory.
● Join a clan of like-minded people, play with friends, and achieve your goals together in this online 4X strategy game.
● Capture territory, climb to the top of the war rankings, and enlist the support of thousands of allies to help you achieve world domination

Total Battle is a war strategy game with various historical epochs: from ancient times to medieval and then to the age of discovery. Join the online battle strategy game, build an empire, and win!

name: Butcher Hero: Monster Idle RPG
summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph
• Make progress with AFK progression and optional auto-battle
• Enjoy the complete single-player game offline
• Challenge other heroes in online PvP

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Your games in one place: games are picked up automatically, anything else you add by hand. A game's home screen shortcut opens it through the app, HUD included, and a widget shows your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Games started from the app or its shortcut get the panel; Auto HUD (VIP) opens it however a game starts.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
Ping stability, free memory and battery temperature, with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. It also shows what the network did: Wi-Fi signal and band, and the minute the signal went weak, the network changed or dropped, or the phone was moving a lot of data. Every session is kept.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads your recorded sessions: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Two sessions of one game are enough to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees.

NETWORK CHECK
Measure: twenty round trips to a public DNS server, with the average, lowest, variation and unanswered samples. Wi-Fi · 4G/5G: both connections measured at the same time, side by side (uses a little mobile data). Regions: time to connect to cloud data centers in 13 regions, to pick a server region in a game's settings. It measures; it cannot change or switch your connection, and never reaches a game's server.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional, once per session each: your usual wobble minute, a hot or low battery, a phone already hot on the charger.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness, set media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Give a game its own Game Mode, or skip it for that game. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" first.

TEST KIT
Touch: how often the screen reports your finger, how many fingers it tracks, and a grid showing any spot that never registers. Display: the refresh rate now, the rates the screen supports, and a dead-pixel check. Controller: every button and both sticks, plus a stick-drift check. It only reads what the hardware reports.

REFLEX TRAINER - ROBOT RANGE
Robots pop up at three distances for 30 seconds; tap each before its ring closes. Three ranges open as you rank up, and the lobby replays the best 10 seconds of your record run. Timed from the frame a robot appears to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU, resolution and refresh rate, it suggests graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows to set in the game yourself. It cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD and Auto Game Mode for games opened from anywhere, plus six things your sessions make possible: a forecast of the next session, battery time left for this game, alerts that learn what is normal for your phone, change since your first sessions, a backup of your session log, and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

10 languages, switchable in the app. "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only for the HUD and are asked for on the HUD screen; notification policy access is only for Do Not Disturb.

description:
Organize your game library, monitor real-time device vitals, and minimize distractions with Game Launcher VIP Ping-GFX HUD!

Game Launcher VIP Ping-GFX HUD is designed as a centralized gaming utility hub. It brings your installed games together in one launcher and provides essential monitoring tools like an in-game HUD, network latency tracking, and a notification silencer for an uninterrupted gaming session.

🎮 Centralized Game Launcher
• Keep all your installed games organized in one clean dashboard.

📊 Real-Time Device & Hardware Monitor
• Ping / Network Latency: Track your current network latency to evaluate connection stability.
• Memory & Storage Stats: View available vs. total system memory usage.
• Battery & Temperature: Keep track of battery percentage, charging state, and battery temperature to prevent unexpected shutdowns.
• GFX & Display Benchmark: View device display resolution, refresh rate, and graphics capability benchmarks.

🛡️ In-Game Performance HUD Overlay
• Keep an eye on vital statistics while actively playing.
• Floating HUD overlay displays your ping, memory metrics, and battery temperature directly on your screen.

🔕 Gamer Mode (Do Not Disturb)
• Focus on your gameplay without interruptions.
• Automatically silences notifications and calls using system Do Not Disturb (DND) settings when Gamer Mode is enabled.

🌐 Local Game Firewall (On-Device VPN)
• Limit background data usage of other apps while you game.
• Uses Android's local VpnService to restrict internet access exclusively for unlisted background apps, helping protect your gaming bandwidth.

💡 Real Utility, No False Promises
Tired of generic "game booster" apps that make unrealistic promises about magic RAM cleaners or instant FPS acceleration? Game Launcher VIP Ping-GFX HUD takes a realistic, transparent approach. We provide genuine utility tools—like background bandwidth restriction, latency tracking, and notification suppression—giving you full control over your device's actual performance without deceptive claims.

🔒 Permissions & Privacy Transparency
We value your privacy and only request permissions required for core utility features:

• VpnService: Used exclusively to run a local loopback firewall that restricts internet access to unselected background apps. No external VPN server is connected, and no network traffic is logged or sent off your device.
• Notification Policy Access (DND): Required to silence incoming notifications and alerts during Gamer Mode.
• Special Use Foreground Service: Used solely to monitor active network ping and keep the in-game HUD overlay responsive while playing.
• Internet: Used for measuring network latency (ping checks) and serving in-app features.

⚠️ Disclaimer
Game Launcher VIP Ping-GFX HUD is a utility and monitoring suite. Unlike misleading "game booster" tools, this app does not overclock, alter, or physically boost device hardware (CPU, GPU, or RAM). Actual gaming performance depends entirely on the hardware specifications provided by your device manufacturer.

name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD
summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills inside the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision, turns them into small per-row adjustments and counts your touch rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• One profile free, three with VIP; every change is saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic shooter layout
• Share a profile as a code or QR code and import a friend's, offline, no account
• VIP: a converter to another template or screen size, and a profile bound to each game

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
New features first, Auto HUD, AI Game Coach for unlimited games, auto setup, AI alerts, the converter, profiles 2 and 3, screen recording from the HUD and the VIP mailbox to the Sensi team. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. Some games have their own rules about on-screen overlays; check the rules of the game you play.

  time doing

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

• Alarm - Get your attention such as for a security camera notification
• Secret - Hide the content of the notification
• Keep a history of your notifications so you review or restore them later
• And many more...

FAQ: https://buzzkillapp.com
BuzzKill is privacy first. There are no ads, no trackers and no data ever leaves your device. Unlike pretty much every app on your phone and the Play Store it doesn't have access to the internet (you can check) so you can be sure that your data is safe.

Looking for a free trial?
BuzzKill cannot connect to the internet to verify purchases, so it does not offer a free trial in the app. However if you're not happy with your purchase, please press the contact support button in the app and I'll refund your order if you're outside of Google Play's returns period.

Wear OS
BuzzKill has a companion app for Wear OS that allows you to trigger certain actions on the watch based on the rules that the phone triggers. For example you can create a rule in BuzzKill to trigger an alarm when you receive a certain notification. With the BuzzKill companion app, you can have the alarm show up on your watch too.

Accessibility Service API
BuzzKill includes an optional accessibility service that allows it automate certain actions on your device. For example you set BuzzKill  to automatically tap a button in a notification. No data is collected and no data leaves the device. You do not need to enable the accessibility service unless you create a rule that uses it.

Does BuzzKill work with phone calls?
Unfortunately phone calls work very differently to notifications and they have limited support in BuzzKill. E.g. you can't set a custom vibration or sound for a phone call, but you can use the unsilence rule to temporarily allow a phone call to unsilence your rule based on the time/location/phone number that is calling.

(PLEASE READ ***IMPORTANT NOTICE*** IN FULL PRODUCT DESCRIPTION BEFORE PURCHASING - NOT ALL COUNTRIES AND/OR AIRPORTS ARE AVAILABLE)

Stuck in the airport terminal with endless delays? 
Live near an airport and want to find out what's going on? 
Have you always wondered what pilots talk to air traffic controllers about? 
Now you can stop wondering and tune in live!

LiveATC for Android provides a quick and easy way to listen in on live conversations between pilots and air traffic controllers near many airports around the world. LiveATC for Android lets you browse by U.S. state or by country to find an airport and listen in to live air traffic conversations at or near a given airport.  You can also use the "Nearby" feature to find an airport near you.  You can then add any channel to your Favorites list for quick and easy access.

The LiveATC Network (http://liveatc.net) is the world's largest network of streaming audio feeds focused solely on aviation, currently covering over 1,200 airports around the world with over 2,000 different audio feeds and growing daily!

Explanation of some of the needed device permissions:

• The "Location" permission is required so that the app can determine what airports are located in your area when you select "Nearby"

• The "Device ID & Call Information" permission is needed by the app so that it can detect when you're placing or receiving a phone call so that it can automatically stop the audio stream to prevent it from interfering with your phone call

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE *** 
Please check to see if your country, city and/or airports of interest are covered by LiveATC *BEFORE PURCHASING* - check at: http://liveatc.net .  Note that we currently have no coverage in the U.K., Belgium, Germany, Iceland, India, Italy, New Zealand, Spain and some other countries where streaming ATC communications is prohibited by local law.  Available airports are subject to change at any time - LiveATC owns and operates many of the receivers used in the network but most are provided by volunteers working in cooperation with LiveATC. Available airports can change, sometimes due to reasons beyond LiveATC's control. Also, there is no guarantee that all feeds will be up 24/7, though we make our best effort to do so and have a great track record of uptime.

Follow LiveATC for feed updates and breaking aviation and ATC-related news:
Twitter: http://twitter.com/liveatc

name: Groundwire: VoIP SIP Softphone
summary: A softphone app with seamless SIP calling and an intuitive VoIP dialer
description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

Enjoy calls that feel like a natural part of your Android phone. Groundwire works with Android's built-in calling features for a smooth, familiar experience, and routes audio intelligently between your phone, speaker, wired headset and connected Bluetooth devices. With your permission, it can also add Groundwire calls to the Phone app's Recents list, so your call history stays easy to find in one place.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

name: FF Sensi Max
summary: Explore control settings, sensitivity values and HUD layouts in one simple app.
description:
FF Sensi MAX is a simple, clean reference app for mobile shooter players who like to explore their game settings before applying them. Browse every control option with a plain-language explanation, plan your sensitivity values and compare HUD layouts, all in one place.

What you can do

Controls guide
Go through categories such as In-Match, Display, Sound and more. Every option comes with a short explanation, so you understand what it does before you change it in your game. Explanations are available in English and Hinglish, and you can switch anytime.

Sensitivity planner
Adjust separate sliders for General, Red Dot, 2x Scope, 4x Scope, Sniper Scope and Free Look. Each tile shows a large live value so you can see your numbers at a glance. Not sure where to start? Tap Shuffle Sensitivity to get a fresh set of values to try.

HUD gallery
Browse a collection of HUD layout screenshots and filter them by two-finger, three-finger and four-finger styles, or by preset layouts. Tap any screenshot to open it full screen and pinch to zoom in on the details.

Phone information
See your phone's name, RAM and free storage, plus a live ping reading, on the home screen. Refresh the details anytime with one tap.

Simple by design
- No ads
- No in-app purchases
- No account or sign-in needed
- No personal data collected

Good to know
This app is a reference and planning tool. It does not change, modify or connect to any game, and it does not give any in-game advantage. Use the values and layouts you like as a guide and apply them manually in your game's own settings menu.

Internet access is used only for the live ping reading and to load the app's font. See our privacy policy for details.

FF Sensi MAX is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Garena or the makers of Free Fire. All game names, trademarks and images belong to their respective owners.

name: Brams Keyboard
summary: 3D keyboard, mechanical sound, RGB and autocorrect in 72 languages. No tracking.
description:
A keyboard that makes you want to type.

Brams is an Android keyboard inspired by 1960s German industrial design: few colors, simple shapes and every detail in service of function. The keys have depth, sink when you tap them and sound like a real mechanical keyboard.

And one rule always holds: what you type never leaves your phone. Brams only uses the internet when you tap Download on a language or Check for language updates, and only to download.

KEYS YOU CAN FEEL
• 3D keys with shadows, side walls and a matte texture that sink with every tap
• 17 keycap shapes, including mechanical keyboard profiles like OEM, SA, DSA, XDA, KAT and MT3
• 22 color themes, each in light, dark and AMOLED
• More than 50 Signature themes you unlock by typing, with Brams Points
• Adjustable backlight and 12 gaming RGB effects: wave, waterfall, breathing, reactive, ripple, starlight, rain, fire and more, in 24 colors
• Caps Lock light, animated key entrance and rounded top corners
• Adjustable height and spacing, one-handed mode and a floating keyboard on tablets

MECHANICAL KEYBOARD SOUNDS
14 sounds, many recorded from real keyboards: Mechanical, Magnetic, Aluminum, Cushioned, Springy and more. Space, Enter and Delete have their own sound. Adjustable vibration, with its own strength for the space bar.

72 LANGUAGES, AUTOCORRECT AND SUGGESTIONS ON YOUR PHONE
From Portuguese, English and Spanish to Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Greek, Hebrew and Thai.
• Your phone's languages come with the app; download the others in Settings (up to 20 MB each). Once downloaded, they work offline, even in airplane mode
• Several languages at once, no switching
• Dedicated Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew, Thai, Arabic-script and Indian (InScript) keyboards; Telex for Vietnamese
• Japanese with kanji conversion, Simplified (pinyin) and Traditional (zhuyin) Chinese, and Korean, all on your phone. The language list is updated when you tap Check for language updates
• Fixes typos and missing accents, and never learns its own mistakes
• Completes the word, predicts the next one from the sentence and remembers the emails you use
• Swipe across the letters to type
• QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Turkish Q, Nordic, Dvorak, Colemak and BÉPO

TRANSLATION WITHOUT LEAVING THE KEYBOARD
Translate what you write into and from 57 languages. Translation happens right on your phone. Each translation language is downloaded in Settings when you want it (about 50 MB); after that, it works offline.

VOICE TYPING, OFFLINE
Tap the microphone and talk. Your speech becomes text right on your phone. Brams only listens while the voice panel is open, and the audio is never saved or sent anywhere.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
• Emoji with search by word or phrase, your choice of size and suggestions as you type
• Clipboard with text and images, pinned items and your choice of how long to keep them
• Hold the space bar to move the cursor like a trackpad
• A toolbar your way, including Switch keyboard
• Text shortcuts and typing statistics with a weekly summary
• Back up your settings and words to a file you keep, password-protected if you want, saved wherever you choose (even Google Drive)

REAL PRIVACY
• No tracking and no data collection: no ads, no analytics, no account
• Brams never sends anything you type, say or copy. The keyboard has no internet code
• Internet only to download: language files come from the Brams server when you tap Download in Settings, each one verified, with no account, cookies or identifiers
• Incognito mode, and no suggestions or learning in password fields
• Optional Brams Blueprint app: on your phone, Brams gives it only your total key count and Brams Points balance when you deposit, and your keyboard layout when you create a theme.

PAY ONCE
No subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads.

* EasyCap including audio with STK1160 + SAA7113/GM7113  (Audio 8kHz mono version VID_05E1&PID_0408)

Please use a good quality OTG cable and ensure power supply. Some devices may need to bridge HUB to enhanced USB signals to work properly, e.g. Elgato Cam link, ezcap Video Grabber.

"USB Camera" can let your android device connect to USB WebCam or video capture card via USB-OTG. You can record video or capture snapshot, OR turn your phone into a wireless IP Camera via build-in RTSP/RTSPS and HTTP/HTTPS Server for security monitoring WITH Bi-directional audio support, you can use your browser to view, of course, include "IP Camera" App.

"USB Camera" can mix USB Audio with a built-in microphone or system audio and output, or overlay the built-in camera/screen video onto the external camera video.

"USB Camera" can push the video and audio to RTMP/SRT live media server and use for network live broadcast. It supports the rtmps security protocol and SRT protocol and it can also push the media to multiple media server at the same time. It also supports HEVC/AV1 over RTMP and can be used for YouTube Live currently.

"USB Camera" supports Side by Side(SBS) view and it can work with FPV goggle

"USB Camera" can add timestamp, GPS, speed and other info on the video frames while recording and can use your headset or Bluetooth headset to capture snapshot and record video. It also supports WebCam's snapshot button.

"USB Camera" supports loop-recording. Can set auto-segment when recording and auto-delete old video archives when no enough storage. "USB Camera" can be used as "Dash Cam"

USB Camera can seamless switching between foreground and background. Just press 'Enter background' from menu. The recording will not interrupted during switching!

It support auto video recording which based on Motion Detection and the video record can be uploaded to FTP server automatically and notify you via Email!

Bi-directional audio requires IP Camera App, you can get it from https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shenyaocn.android.WebCamPro 

IMPORTANT! On Android 9 and above, Camera permission is required to get fully USB Video device access.

This is userspace driver so it used for the app only. Android does not allow to install kernel driver so it unable to use for third-party apps.
